Quali saranno le tue attività
Monitorare e interpretare l'evoluzione del quadro normativo nazionale ed europeo applicabile ai Digital Asset, con particolare riguardo a MiCAR, DLT Pilot Regime, Decreto Fintech
Analizzare l'evoluzione del mercato dei Digital Asset, in termini di strumenti, mercati e tecnologie, valutandone gli impatti normativi e di compliance
Fornire consulenza specialistica nell'ambito di eventuali progettualità innovative, individuando i requisiti normativi applicabili e contribuendo alla definizione dei relativi presidi operativi, organizzativi e di controllo, in modo da garantire il rispetto della normativa di riferimento
Guidare attività di analisi normativa e gap assessment
Collaborare con Process Owner e Control Owner alla definizione e revisione dei processi operativi e dei controlli di primo livello e contribuire alla progettazione/rafforzamento dei controlli di secondo livello
Predisporre pareri e approfondimenti specialistici su tematiche regolamentari e di compliance
Gestire le interlocuzioni con le autorità competenti, supportando la gestione di richieste informative, verifiche e attività autorizzative
Contribuire all'evoluzione del framework di compliance aziendale, promuovendo l'adozione delle best practice di mercato e l'integrazione dei requisiti normativi nei processi aziendali
Chi stiamo cercando
Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando:
Esperienza professionale di almeno 3-5 anni in funzioni Compliance, Legal, Risk Management o Internal Control presso intermediari finanziari, società fintech o operatori del settore Crypto-Asset (CASP o ex VASP).
Solida conoscenza della normativa applicabile ai Crypto-Asset e più in generale agli strumenti finanziari digitali, con particolare riferimento a MiCAR, DLT Pilot Regime, Decreto Fintech e principali evoluzioni regolamentari europee.
Esperienza nella gestione di progetti regolamentari, nell'analisi di impatto normativo e nella definizione di processi e controlli.
Laurea in Economia, Giurisprudenza, Ingegneria o discipline affini; costituiscono titolo preferenziale percorsi di specializzazione in ambito Cripto Asset /Digital Asset /Block chain.
Interesse per l'innovazione digitale, la tecnologia blockchain e l'evoluzione dei mercati finanziari.
Buona capacità di operare in autonomia, gestendo contemporaneamente attività progettuali e tematiche di compliance complesse.
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta sia parlata.

Overview
Entrerai a far parte del team dedicato agli investimenti diretti in Private Debt, riportando al Responsabile dell’area. Parteciperai a tutte le fasi del processo di investimento: analisi e valutazione delle opportunità, esecuzione delle operazioni e monitoraggio del portafoglio. Collaborerai con stakeholder interni ed esterni, incluse funzioni aziendali, strutture di controllo, consulenti, intermediari finanziari e società partecipate, contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di investimento e alla gestione delle attività del team.
Quali saranno le tue attività
Tra le principali responsabilità:
Analisi del merito creditizio di operazioni di finanza strutturata e acquisition financing per imprese
Sviluppo di modelli finanziari per la valutazione delle proiezioni economico-finanziarie e della sostenibilità dell’indebitamento
Coordinamento del processo di due diligence, in collaborazione con le funzioni di Risk Management, Compliance ed ESG
Redazione dei credit memorandum, attribuzione del rating di credito e presentazione delle operazioni ai Comitati Investimenti
Revisione della documentazione legale e supporto all’esecuzione e al closing delle transazioni
Monitoraggio del portafoglio investimenti, con revisione periodica del merito creditizio, analisi delle performance e verifica del rispetto dei covenant finanziari
Gestione delle relazioni con investitori, advisor, sponsor e società clienti.
Chi stiamo cercando
Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando:
3-5 anni di esperienza nella strutturazione, negoziazione e gestione di operazioni di finanziamento a medio-lungo termine a favore di imprese, incluse operazioni assistite da schemi di garanzia nazionali e sovranazionali (es. SACE, BEI), dall’analisi creditizia e approvazione fino all’erogazione, monitoraggio ed exit.
Approfondita conoscenza del mercato del Private Debt, della relativa normativa di riferimento e dei principali strumenti di finanza d’impresa, quali prestiti senior, obbligazioni corporate, strumenti subordinati e finanziamenti mezzanini.
Capacità di valutazione del rischio di credito, analisi finanziaria e strutturazione di soluzioni di finanziamento complesse.
Familiarità con la documentazione finanziaria e contrattuale connessa alle operazioni di debito privato.
Cosa ti offriamo
Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 42.000 €
Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo
Elementi complementari disciplinati dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale Credito e accordi aziendali di secondo livello
Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone
Ampia offerta formativa tramite la Corporate Academy dedicata allo sviluppo continuo delle competenze professionali, manageriali e trasversali a tutti i livelli
Possibilità di aderire al lavoro flessibile e alla settimana corta 4x9
Sistema moderno e integrato di welfare aziendale ( link )
Copertura sanitaria e previdenza complementare a decorrere dall’assunzione
Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo

Qonto::7d508564-98c1-4cca-8633-dc8e87b7f.title: Senior Product Engineer - iOS/Swift
Qonto::7d508564-98c1-4cca-8633-dc8e87b7f.text:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).
Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
Location: You can choose to work at Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, Portugal, or Spain.
Mission
Join us as an iOS Engineer and help us build the most intuitive mobile banking experience for European businesses. You'll be crafting features that directly impact the daily financial operations of over 600,000 SMEs across Europe, making their business finance simpler and more efficient.
As an iOS Engineer at Qonto, you will:
Craft cutting-edge financial features: Work on critical architectural and UI features that will directly impact our end users.
Foster meaningful collaboration: Work closely with back-end teams, designers, and product managers to create a unified vision.
Solve real-time challenges: Tackle real-time synchronization issues and spearhead new initiatives.
Champion quality: Maintain an exceptional level of quality by implementing continuous refactoring and unit testing to consistently enhance the codebase.
What you can expect
You'll be building for Europe's fastest-growing business banking market, with 600K+ clients across multiple countries and ambitious expansion plans
Work in an environment that prioritizes quality, comprehensive code reviews, component approach and continuous refactoring as standard practice
Contribute to a fully Swift-based app using MVP and Coordinators architecture, with modern CI/CD through GitHub, Firebase, and Bitrise
Access to expert mentorship, Tech Weeklies & Monthlies, and conference opportunities to stay at the forefront of iOS development
Our methodology, the Qonto Way
We value upfront technical design, team reviews, and smart slicing, quality drives the velocity our customers need;
Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates;
Our lean toolbox, Kaizen, PDCA, lets you monitor and drive continuous improvement collaboratively with your peers and manager;
Each engineer gets access to Cursor or Copilot, and we want people who use AI to raise the bar, not just to go faster.
Your future team
As an iOS Engineer, you will join one of Qonto's squad teams, each organized around a clear project mission, with one team lead and full ownership of a product scope. You'll be part of a 140 mobile engineering community within a 500 Product Engineering department, working in focused teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Frontend and Backend.
Our stack & practices
Our app is 100% Swift, built on MVP & Clean Architecture with 35+ independent modules. We use the Coordinator pattern for scalability, and all new screens are built in SwiftUI (MVVM) with async/await — 80+ screens already migrated. Project generation and build optimization run on Tuist. CI/CD covers GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Firebase Test Lab, Sonar, and Fastlane.
We take technical excellence seriously: 30,000+ unit tests, 450+ snapshot tests, SwiftyMocky for mock generation, and LLMs integrated into our dev workflow. Our modular architecture (32 reusable modules + centralized design system) ensures fast builds, clear ownership, and safe iterations.
Want to know more about our mobile performance indicators? Read this.
About You
iOS Expertise: Proven experience as a Mobile engineer with strong Swift skills and deep understanding of the iOS ecosystem, SDK, and development lifecycle
Quality-driven development: Strong commitment to best practices, including unit testing (XCTests, FBSnapshots), Clean code / SOLID principles, and organized workflows
Problem-solving approach: Pragmatic and solution-oriented approach to engineering challenges, with ability to deliver tangible value in a fast-paced environment
Collaborative spirit: Excellent communication skills, fluent english and experience working effectively in cross-functional teams with both technical and non-technical colleagues
Growth mindset: Curious and proactive developer who thrives on learning new technologies and contributing to a product serving hundreds of thousands of users

Satispay::2c680afe-9fc6-4fbf-9e9d-598c13.title: Senior Product Manager
Satispay::2c680afe-9fc6-4fbf-9e9d-598c13.text:
ABOUT US
Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance. That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we're not done. Not even close.
We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
As a Senior Product Manager at Satispay, you'll take ownership of one of our core product domains — payments, credit, investing, cards, or merchant solutions — and turn it into a simple, engaging experience for millions of users. The exact domain will be shaped around your background and our current priorities, but the day-to-day looks like this:
Roadmap ownership — Own the roadmap for your product area end to end, from opportunity sizing to shipped feature, backed by data and user research.
Complexity, made simple — Navigate the regulatory and technical complexity that comes with building financial products, while keeping the experience radically simple for the end user.
Compliance collaboration — Work closely with compliance, legal, and risk teams given the regulated nature of financial products.
User research — Talk to users constantly (interviews, usability tests, support tickets) and turn what you hear into concrete product decisions.
Execution & iteration — Define specs and work day-to-day with design and engineering to ship, then iterate based on what the numbers tell you.
KPI management — Track and own your core KPIs (activation, adoption, volumes/revenue) and report on them without spin.
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
This role needs someone data-driven and user-centric, who thrives on turning complex financial products into simple, engaging consumer experiences — and who's excited to bring that mindset to one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs.
Experience — At least 5+ years of experience in a Product Manager role, ideally within fintech, paytech, or another consumer-facing scale-up, with exposure to regulated products (payments, lending, investing, insurance) or genuine technical/operational complexity.
Fintech / paytech mindset — You bring a proven track record of building and scaling consumer or B2B financial products, paired with a genuine, contagious passion for the world of finance and payments.
Data-driven mindset — You build hypotheses, validate them, and rely on analytics to lead the way.
User-centric focus — You prioritize direct user feedback and research over unverified assumptions.
Cross-functional collaboration — You thrive working alongside designers and engineers every day, staying involved far beyond just handing over specifications.
Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.
CAREABOUT: HOW WE SUPPORT YOUR IMPACT
We move fast, and evolution never stops. It's a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we're committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That's why we created CareAbout:
❤️ Health — Private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
💰 Financial resources — Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you're moving countries.
⚙️ Growth and development — Professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.
🌱 Flexibility — Unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.
👨‍👩‍👧 Family — Enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
*We embrace 2 days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday), with the option to request extra remote time.
Salary: €68,000 - €87,000 gross per annum
This range is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role's core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless — for instance — of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.
Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!
LEARN MORE ABOUT US
Our values and pillars aren't just fancy words on a page - they really shape everything we do. Explore them here https://www.satispay.com/en-it/work-at-satispay/.
By submitting this application, I acknowledge that I have read and understood the content of the Privacy Policy https://www.satispay.com/en-it/legal-hub/privacy-policy/candidates/

Howden::/job/London/Finance-Manager--18-.title: Finance Manager (18 month FTC)
Howden::/job/London/Finance-Manager--18-.text:
Who are we?
Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.
People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.
What we’re looking for
Howden is seeking a Finance Manager to be part of a team leading on legal entity reporting for circa 25 holding and treasury companies, covering monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting, as well as financial planning during the budgeting cycle. It suits someone with team leadership experience and strong technical knowledge in financial instruments, intercompany transactions, reconciliations, share movements, and statutory reporting.
The role also requires understanding M&A and restructuring impacts on entity and group reporting, translating complex transactions into clear accounting. A tech-savvy mindset is key, with a focus on streamlining processes and collaborating across finance, legal, tax, and operations teams.
Please note that this is a fixed-term contract, full-time role based in our Central London office. Following a hybrid work pattern, you are expected to be onsite 2-3 days per week on average. The fixed term contract is until March 2028.
What you’ll be doing
Reporting and Controls:
Manage monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting for legal entities.
Lead month-end close and balance sheet reconciliations.
Coordinate quarterly controls and lender attestations.
Support interim reviews and annual audits.
Prepare and review sections of consolidated accounts.
Team Leadership:
Lead and coach a team of accountants with a focus on continuous improvement.
Identify process hurdles and drive simplification of monthly close.
Promote knowledge sharing and manage performance reviews.
Statutory Accounts:
Oversee preparation of UK and Jersey statutory accounts
Directly prepare complex accounts (e.g. parent entity, treasury companies).
Coordinate with tax, external providers, and internal teams.
Liaise with external and internal auditors, managing audit queries efficiently.
Budgeting and Forecasting:
Lead annual budget and reforecasting for legal entities.
Resolve issues impacting group holding companies, including interaction with divisional budgets.
Technical Accounting:
Prepare accounting papers for financing, hedging, and share transactions.
Coordinate with Shares team and external advisors to meet deadlines.
Address ad hoc accounting issues as they arise.
Project and Initiative Support:
Contribute to treasury initiatives (e.g. cash pooling).
Support reorganisations, recharges, and business transfers.
Engage team in cross-functional reporting and improvement projects.
Assist with fair value assessments, impairment testing, and M&A accounting.
Review and enhance accounting policies related to legal entity reporting.
What qualifications we’re looking for
Hands-on experience in key accounting areas – including financial reporting, general ledger and consolidation systems, IFRS 9 (financial instruments), intercompany transactions, investments/dividends, IFRS 2 (share-based payments), and valuations. Exposure to consolidation and acquisition accounting (IFRS 3) is a plus.
Solid technical foundation of IFRS and UK GAAP, with ability to apply standards in practice.
Experience managing and developing a team of at least three people.
Able to manage tasks, allocate responsibilities, and balance competing priorities effectively.
Able to explain accounting concepts to non-finance stakeholders and support cross-functional collaboration.
Awareness of Companies Act requirements and legal obligations related to financial reporting and statutory accounts.
What do we offer in return?
A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond
Reasonable adjustments
We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.
If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.
*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.
Fixed Term Contract (Fixed Term)

Wise::744000150706819.title: Internal Audit Senior Manager
Wise::744000150706819.text:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
A bit about the role
We are looking for an Internal Audit Senior Manager for the Wise Assets portfolio to join our fast growing IA team.
Your main responsibilities will include overseeing the delivery of internal audits of Wise Assets (Wise’s investment product), and collaborating internally and externally with partnering firms. You will make recommendations to improve governance, risk management and internal controls. You will also play a vital role in performing audit plan development and risk assessment activities in the portfolio. You will be responsible for planning, assigning, and supervising the operational activities of the team as well as completing your own tasks.
The role presents a great opportunity to focus on the development and delivery of audit engagements in a fast paced environment, focussed on data driven audit techniques and continuous monitoring. Relevant experience working in assurance, risk or control roles and deploying technology enabled assurance is key to driving the internal audit agenda.
We are a 5 year old team that is still forming and storming (we have grown from 2 to 50+ people in this time), therefore you have the unique opportunity to collaborate and shape the operations, methodology and approaches of the Internal Audit function.
Your mission
Support the implementation and operation of the internal audit assurance framework, including development of continuous monitoring and automated audit routines.
Support development of the annual audit plan for the non-financial Risk & Regulatory domain, including the audit universe, risk assessment processes and budgeting processes.
Deliver audits per the audit plan to ensure timely and relevant audit outcomes.
Support in building and supporting a strong and self-sufficient internal audit team.
Monitor the implementation of Internal Audit recommendations by the teams and measure the effectiveness of the improvements.
Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders, internally and externally.
The role is UK-based, but many of our teams are located across different office locations. You will travel as needed to meet your objectives.
A bit about you
Skills:
You have clear working knowledge of investment management and investment services processes and expected controls and worked in these areas or performed audits in these areas. You are familiar with the applicable UK and EU regulations (MIFIR/D, COBS, IFR, AML/CFT etc.))
You have proven experience working in risk, control or assurance and you want to continuously improve how to get the job done.
You have working knowledge of global regulatory frameworks and requirements relevant to payments, fintech and/or broader financial services firms, such as Consumer Protection & Conduct, Outsourcing & Third Party Management, Risk Management, Governance, and Regulatory Reporting.
You have worked in technology, fintech or broader financial services industries.
You are able to work independently, you assume responsibility and you make your own judgement.
You are prepared to take ownership over complex new areas and solve problems with no or very limited guidance and know when to escalate and ask for support.
You have very strong coordination skills and you are able to hold teams accountable for meeting deadlines and delivering high quality outputs.
You are agile and adaptable to change.
You seek to use data analytics and technology in your work and decision making processes. Practical experience in data analytics preferred.
You demonstrate attention to details but can summarise key messages succinctly, verbally and in writing, adjusting your style and level of information based on the target audience.
You’re curious - you’re great at asking insightful questions to understand the real issues and deliver the right outcomes.
You are passionate about driving change, making improvements and helping stakeholders.
You are not afraid of making decisions, can work autonomously and take initiative.
You’re a strong relationship builder across all levels of the business and externally. You manage and influence stakeholders with ease.
You are collaborative - you enjoy sharing your knowledge and upskilling others.
Experience:
At least 8 years of relevant experience in assurance, risk or control roles, in investment management and services areas.
You have led and managed collaboration projects involving internal and external teams.
You have worked in a multinational environment across different cultures and countries.
Professional qualification: CPA/ACA/ACCA/CIA/CISA.
You have worked in regulated environments, Fintech or Financial Services.
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs .
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram .

Airwallex::67822c40-c428-47a7-b93c-eafb8.title: Senior Manager, Merchant Risk Operations, APAC [Relocation to Singapore]
Airwallex::67822c40-c428-47a7-b93c-eafb8.location: SG - Singapore | AE - Dubai | CN - Shanghai | NL - Amsterdam | IE - Dublin | US - Remote | TW - Taipei | CN - Shenzhen | UK - London | HK - Hong Kong SAR
Airwallex::67822c40-c428-47a7-b93c-eafb8.text:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX
Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 676,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.
We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.
As part of our Risk Operations team, you’ll be responsible for strengthening our global risk control strategy, managing a well-performed risk operation team and ensuring portfolio risk level aligned with the enterprise risk appetite. You are a self-starter and independent thinker with exceptional analytical and communication skills, capable of solving complex problems that will drive the evolution of our business.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Lead APAC Merchant Risk Operations team for Payments
Own end‑to‑end operational performance for APAC merchant risk operations, including SLAs, quality, loss metrics, and customer impact
Oversee design and execution of merchant monitoring, investigation and escalation workflows across APAC region
Partner with global legal, risk and compliance team to implement new policies and control changes efficiently into operations
Work with Product and Engineering to evolve risk tooling (rules engines, case management, AI/LLM‑based workflows, analytics surfaces) for higher accuracy and efficiency
Champion automation and AI to reduce manual work, speed up decisions, and improve reviewer effectiveness while maintaining strong control standards
Drive the key performance metrics (fraud ratio, chargeback ratio, etc) in MRM team to meet the company OKR
Proactive stakeholder management including risk, compliance, commercial, product etc.
Always challenge the status quo and continuously strive for operational excellence
WHO YOU ARE
You are an experienced risk operations leader who is equally comfortable in the details of complex cases and in board‑level conversations about strategy and risk appetite. You know how to scale teams, influence cross‑functional stakeholders, and build systems that enable both growth and protection.
We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:
8+ years of experience in payments / fintech / acquiring with at least 3+ years people management experiences
Deep expertise in one or more of Merchant Risk:
credit and fraud risk ( reserves and exposure management)
brand risk (AUP and compliance management)
Proven track record managing senior ICs in multi‑location teams
Demonstrated ability to operate fast in ambiguity, set clear priorities, and drive outcomes in a fast‑moving, high‑growth environment
A strong desire to learn about new payment trends and technologies.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Strong analytical and data skills – comfortable using dashboards and data tools to diagnose issues, design experiments, and measure impact
Experience building or scaling risk operations in a global fintech or top‑tier payments company
Hands‑on experience partnering with Product/Engineering to design risk tooling or automation, including use of AI/ML/LLMs in operations
Mandarin language proficiency.
APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS
To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.
Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Visa::/job/GB---London-United-Kingdom/Ma.title: MarTech Manager
Visa::/job/GB---London-United-Kingdom/Ma.text:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Job Description
Role purpose and responsibilities:
Support Europe Marketing Services teams as a MarTech subject matter specialist, providing guidance on marketing automation, client use cases and implementation considerations, helping local teams and clients shape practical, scalable solutions across marketing automation, data-driven engagement, AI-enabled marketing, measurement, and future capability areas.
Translate local market needs, client ambitions, and technical MarTech requirements into clear use cases, solution designs, implementation considerations, and commercially relevant recommendations.
Support client discovery and solutioning conversations with confidence, explaining complex MarTech capabilities in simple, practical language while assessing readiness across data, integrations, consent, content, journeys, measurement, governance, and delivery.
Enable local Marketing Services teams to identify the right opportunities, position capabilities such as VM360 and future AI-enabled solutions, and move client opportunities from concept to implementation readiness.
Partner with Global Marketing Services, Product, Technology, Data, Legal, Privacy, VCA, Sales, Insights & Analytics, and local market teams to ensure solutions are commercially attractive, technically feasible, compliant, and scalable.
Build repeatable tools, guidance, discovery questions, requirements templates, solution narratives, training materials, and governance approaches that improve sales confidence, delivery efficiency, and best-practice sharing across Europe.
Monitor emerging MarTech and AI developments and share relevant insights that may enhance client solutions and service offerings by anticipating future capability needs and translating emerging technologies into practical client value.
What we expect of you, day to day:
Act as a regional subject matter expert for MarTech-enabled Marketing Services capabilities, starting with VM360 and expanding to future automation, data-driven, and AI-enabled marketing solutions.
Work with cluster and local Marketing Services teams to capture technical MarTech requirements, translate them into clear business and solution requirements, and identify implications for data, integration, content, consent, measurement, and delivery.
Support and participate in client conversations, confidently explaining marketing automation, AI-enabled marketing, data-driven engagement, implementation considerations, and how MarTech can help improve activation, engagement, retention, and usage outcomes.
Shape client-specific MarTech use cases across the customer lifecycle, including onboarding, service-led communications, activation, usage stimulation, retention, personalisation, AI-assisted optimisation, and always-on engagement programmes.
Assess client and local market readiness for MarTech delivery, identifying required inputs, dependencies, risks, data availability, governance needs, and operational steps required to move from opportunity to implementation.
Partner with Product, Technology, Data, Legal, Privacy, VCA, Sales, Insights & Analytics, and Global Marketing Services to ensure client requirements are clearly understood and solutions are commercially attractive, technically feasible, compliant, and scalable.
Develop practical tools, guidance, training, FAQs, discovery questions, and sales enablement materials that help local teams identify MarTech opportunities and discuss technical solutions with confidence.
Capture learnings from early MarTech engagements, define repeatable delivery approaches, support capability governance, and share MarTech best practices across the European and Global Marketing Services community.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
Qualifications
Proven experience working with marketing technology platforms, marketing automation tools, CRM or customer engagement systems, and/or customer data-driven marketing solutions.
Strong understanding of how marketing platforms use customer data, segmentation, consent, content, journeys, triggers, integrations, reporting, and measurement to deliver automated marketing programmes.
Ability to translate business objectives and local market requirements into structured MarTech use cases, solution designs, implementation considerations, and pragmatic recommendations.
Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple, commercially relevant language to both internal stakeholders and client audiences.
Solid understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, activation, usage, retention, personalisation, and campaign measurement, ideally in financial services, payments, loyalty, or customer engagement environments.
Working knowledge of data quality, privacy, consent, compliance, and governance considerations relevant to marketing automation and client data activation.
Ability to collaborate effectively across marketing, sales, product, technology, data, legal, privacy, and analytics teams in a matrixed regional environment.
Comfortable working through ambiguity, managing multiple workstreams, documenting requirements, solving problems, and moving opportunities from concept to implementation readiness.
Willingness to travel and work onsite with clients and local teams when necessary.
Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Visa::/job/GB---London-United-Kingdom/Se.title: Senior B2B Events Marketing Manager
Visa::/job/GB---London-United-Kingdom/Se.text:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Job Description
Visa Commercial Solutions (VCS) is seeking an experienced Senior B2B Events Marketing Manager to drive impactful event programming across Europe that aligns with VCS business priorities.
This role requires a customer-centric focus and a strategic mindset in developing and executing B2B event programming for VCS that supports commercial priorities, fosters brand engagement, and generates business opportunities. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of collaborating with key internal stakeholders to produce events aligned to strategic objectives and measurable outcomes.
Responsibilities may include:
Event Programming: Develop, plan, and execute B2B event programming for VCS proprietary, client, and industry events, ensuring alignment with sales, marketing, product, and communication priorities.
Cross-Functional & Regional Collaboration: Partner with VCS stakeholders across functions, including sales, product, marketing, communications, leadership, and regional teams, to define event objectives, messaging, and target audiences.
Content Development: Alongside communications and subject matter experts, curate compelling content and engagement formats that deliver value to attendees and drive engagement.
Lead Generation: Design B2B event experiences that maximize lead capture, nurture, and conversion opportunities for VCS sales teams.
Performance Measurement: Establish KPIs and measure event performance, providing post-event analysis and recommendations for continuous improvement.
Project Management: Drive workstreams to ensure projects stay on track, adapting and consulting with leadership as required.
Vendor & Partner Management: Manage relationships with event organizers, partners, and vendors to ensure seamless event execution.
Brand Consistency: Ensure events reflect Visa’s brand playbook, maintaining consistency across regions and event types.
Budget Management: Oversee workstream budgets, negotiate contracts.
Market Trends: Stay informed on global event trends, technologies, and best practices, applying innovative solutions to enhance event impact.
Successful Candidate Qualities
Must possess a passion for events and in-depth understanding of how events engagement bolsters brand and supports business objectives
Creative approach to development of event concepts – think outside the box – with a desire to constantly innovate and improve all event aspects
Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship management skills, particularly with senior executive level stakeholders
Demonstrated exceptional project management, organization and planning skills applied in a fast paced, multi-tasking environment
Self-directed personality that takes a proactive, hands-on role in problem solving, decision-making, creating new procedures and innovating new ways to enhance existing processes
Strong customer orientation - look to deliver impactful and beneficial events for clients and attendees with a focus on quality
Must be able to support domestic and international event programmes across Europe, as required. The role requires regional travel, typically up to five business days per month, and from time to time overtime and weekend work.
This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.
Qualifications
Experience in B2B event program development, production, operations, budgeting, and measurement
Proven track record of planning and executing creative, engaging B2B events that drive business outcomes
Strong tradeshow/exhibition management experience, including partnering with product, innovation and marketing teams in creating impactful experiences that drive audience engagement
Strong stakeholder and executive management in global, matrixed organisations
Experience in managing lead generation and capture, data and CRM management
Familiarity with event marketing and sales CRM systems, such as MS Dynamics, Salesforce, Eloqua, Marketo, Cvent, Swoogo
Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Visa::/job/GB---London-United-Kingdom/Se.title: Senior Manager, B2B Acceptance Growth - Acquiring
Visa::/job/GB---London-United-Kingdom/Se.text:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Job Description
Help Europe's leading acquirers grow B2B payment volume by identifying opportunities, developing growth strategies, strengthening capabilities, commercializing new solutions and accelerating supplier adoption.
Role Purpose
Partner with Visa's priority European acquirers and acquirer-issuer partners to accelerate B2B payment acceptance growth by identifying commercial opportunities, developing growth strategies, strengthening B2B capabilities, and supporting the delivery of scalable acceptance solutions.
The role combines business development, strategic client engagement, and solution advisory support to help acquirers grow commercial payment volume, increase supplier acceptance, commercialize new capabilities, and unlock new payment flows.
Role Summary
This individual will serve as a trusted advisor and growth partner to Visa's priority acquirer and acquirer-issuer clients, helping them identify, develop and convert B2B payment opportunities.
Working closely with Product, Commercialization, Acceptance, Issuing, VCA, VAS, Sales and regional market teams, the role will help clients:
Build stronger sales pipelines and grow commercial payment volume
Expand B2B supplier acceptance
Assess current capabilities and growth constraints
Build and strengthen B2B payment propositions
Develop and execute B2B growth strategies
Increase supplier adoption and payment volume
Commercialise new acceptance capabilities and solutions
Scale successful models across markets, industries and supplier segments
The role requires a blend of commercial acumen, B2B acquiring expertise, strategic thinking, client engagement and business development experience.
Key Responsibilities:
Acquirer Growth & Business Development:
Manage a portfolio of priority European acquirers.
Build relationships with senior commercial, product, sales and acquiring leaders.
Identify and develop B2B acceptance growth opportunities.
Lead strategic discussions around B2B acceptance growth, investment priorities and market opportunities.
Support acquirers in building and executing B2B sales and growth plans.
Develop growth strategies focused on supplier acquisition, activation and payment volume growth.
Facilitate workshops, planning sessions and executive engagements.
Translate market opportunities into actionable commercial initiatives and client roadmaps.
Help acquirers identify and prioritise opportunities across key industries, verticals and supplier segments.
B2B Strategy & Advisory:
Assess acquirer B2B acceptance capabilities, market positioning and competitive strengths.
Identify capability gaps and opportunities to accelerate growth.
Bring industry best practices and competitive insights to client engagements.
Develop business cases and value propositions to support client investment decisions.
Advise clients on go-to-market strategies, sales motions and execution priorities.
Support the development of B2B acceptance growth plans and multi-year roadmaps.
Solution Development & Commercialisation:

Wise::744000151064849.title: AI Implementation Senior Manager, TGS
Wise::744000151064849.text:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
At Wise, our mission is money without borders — instant, convenient, transparent, and eventually free. We help people and businesses move money across borders. Delivering that mission requires operational services that are fast, accurate and scalable.
Our Customer Support (CS) and Know Your Customer (KYC) Operations teams are expanding their use of artificial intelligence (AI) to support colleagues and improve how work gets done. We’re looking for an AI Implementation Senior Manager to turn operational challenges into practical AI solutions for our global teams.
You’ll join Transformation, Governance and Strategy (TGS), the team that designs and delivers initiatives and governance frameworks to help Wise’s operations scale, and report to the Head of TGS.
Your mission
This is primarily an independent, hands-on builder role. You’ll spend most of your time designing, building, integrating and improving AI solutions. Your seniority will be reflected in technical judgement, ownership of delivery and your ability to influence across teams.
You’ll take solutions from opportunity discovery and prototype through deployment and ongoing improvement. Working with operational experts, Product and Engineering, you’ll ensure they fit Wise’s architecture, use reliable business data and deliver measurable value.
What you’ll do
Identify opportunities: Work with operational teams and TGS specialists to understand complex workflows and prioritise opportunities for AI assistance or automation.
Build and integrate solutions: Design and develop AI agents using approved platforms and custom code where needed. Map data flows, connect reliable knowledge sources and integrate outputs into existing tools without unnecessary manual workarounds or duplicate systems.
Assess and improve enterprise data readiness: Understand how operational data is created, defined and connected across Wise’s systems. Identify authoritative sources and assess their quality, completeness, freshness, accessibility and business context for each use case. Work with data and system owners to resolve gaps, clarify definitions and establish reliable data flows so AI agents can produce accurate, actionable results.
Deliver with partner teams: Work with operational experts and AI Champions to test solutions against real needs. Coordinate technical dependencies and deployment with Product and Engineering, and engage Privacy, Security and Compliance throughout delivery.
Monitor and improve: Maintain the agents you build, monitor their accuracy and reliability, and improve them as business needs and technology evolve.
Enable wider adoption: Document solutions, contribute to the central AI knowledge wiki and share reusable approaches that help colleagues build their capabilities.
Essential experience
Practical AI implementation: Demonstrable experience building AI agents or automations, including designing, testing and improving prompts and agent workflows.
Enterprise data fluency and readiness: You can navigate a complex enterprise data landscape and assess whether the available data is fit for an AI use case. You understand data ownership, lineage, business definitions and relationships across systems. You can identify missing context, inconsistent records and access constraints, then work with the right teams to address them.
Systems and data integration: You can use SQL, APIs and connectors to give AI agents reliable business context and integrate their outputs into operational workflows. You design data flows with appropriate permissions, maintainability and alignment with existing architecture.
Software development: Experience building tools or extending platforms when off-the-shelf solutions do not meet the need. You can turn prototypes into tested, documented and maintainable software.
AI and architecture judgement: An understanding of how large language models (LLMs) behave and fit into backend systems. You can evaluate outputs, recognise limitations and make design choices that support scalability and avoid unnecessary technical debt.
Independent delivery: A track record of taking ownership from problem definition through delivery. You build relationships, resolve dependencies and align your work with Product and Engineering’s technical direction.
Testing and iteration: Comfort working through ambiguity, testing ideas empirically and using what you learn to improve solutions.
Clear communication: The ability to translate operational needs into technical requirements and explain solutions clearly to technical and operational colleagues.
Desirable experience
Experience with platforms such as Credal, Gemini, Agentspace, NotebookLM, Codex, Replit, Claude.
Knowledge of Payments, Customer Support, Financial Crime or KYC operations.
Experience navigating enterprise data lakes, warehouses and lakehouses.
Experience using Google Apps Script or JavaScript to prototype operational solutions.
What success looks like
Your impact will be measured by the practical value your solutions deliver:
Operational impact: Measurable reductions in manual effort and cost per case, or increased capacity, while maintaining service quality and compliance.
Adoption and usefulness: Sustained use and positive feedback from the operational teams using your solutions.
Quality and reliability: Deployed agents meet agreed accuracy and reliability standards, with performance monitored and improved over time.
Salary for the role: £83000 to £110000 annually (+RSU's)
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

Join our finance team and help navigate us through a critical transformation
The Finance team is critical in supporting the Wise mission. We are working to become listed in the US stock exchange in 2026 and need to ensure our technical accounting team is set-up to meet the respective regulatory requirements.
We’re looking for a HEAD OF TECHNICAL ACCOUNTING to join us
We’re looking for a Head of Technical Accounting to join and lead our technical accounting team. You will play a pivotal role in ensuring the accounting for our new products and services is in accordance with US GAAP and IFRS to meet our reporting needs. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are passionate about financial leadership, we welcome you to apply.
Your mission
The Technical Accounting team is responsible for understanding the why and how of different accounting areas. This includes documenting accounting position papers and explaining to Finance stakeholders, diverse teams across Wise as well as external auditors the accounting for these. You will be overseeing the team’s work and supporting them in the analysis of various accounting topics.
Collaborate cross-functionally to embed accounting into the business - not just the books: You will collaborate with different teams in Finance to ensure correct application of IFRS and US GAAP and that processes and accounting policies are updated to reflect it.
Design scalable processes and systems to support rapid growth and future listing in US stock exchange: You are taking ownership for the management of several high-stakes financial workstreams to ensure compliance with financial reporting standards for both internal and external reporting purposes.
Act as the primary contact with auditors and other stakeholders from the Technical Accounting team side.
Lead and mentor the Technical Accounting team and support them in the transformation journey.
About you
Very good US GAAP and IFRS knowledge. It would be beneficial, if you have a professional finance qualification such as the ACA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent.
You have prior experience (5+ years) as a Technical Accounting Lead, Senior Technical Accountant, Senior Accounting Adviser or Senior Audit Manager. You have managed accounting projects and demonstrated resilience to break through and overcome challenges.
You have prior experience in the SOX controls framework and have improved accounting processes in light of the SOX requirements.
You drive process improvements to enhance financial operations and reporting efficiency.
You are able to work in a fast-paced environment, staying organized and ensuring execution of complex initiatives, driving impact at scale.
You have excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
You have robust communication skills and strong stakeholder management.
You are an inclusive people leader, who develops talent and builds diverse teams.
You are happy to travel on a quarterly basis internationally to other Wise offices (e.g. Tallinn) or for team offsites.
Nice to have
Experience with capital markets transactions (IPO, debt/equity offerings, prospectuses/circulars)
Financial services/fintech industry exposure

We are looking for an Internal Audit Senior Specialist to join our fast-growing Internal Audit team, specifically supporting our assurance work across the Finance & Treasury domain.
Your main task will be to coordinate and execute internal audits at Wise, supporting teams to deliver the audit plan. You will provide assurance on high-risk financial and treasury processes as well as financial regulatory obligations, making recommendations to improve governance and internal controls.
The role presents a great opportunity to focus on the development and delivery of audit engagements in a fast paced environment, focussed on data driven audit techniques and continuous monitoring. Relevant experience working in assurance, risk or control roles and deploying technology enabled assurance is key to driving the internal audit agenda.
We are a newly formed team, therefore you have the unique opportunity to collaborate and shape the operations, methodology and approaches of the Internal Audit function.
Your mission

Support the delivery of our risk-based Audit plan, specifically in the Finance & Treasury domain (including Financial Risk), to ensure timely and relevant audit outcomes.
Responsible for planning, executing and reporting internal audits in accordance with the Wise Audit methodology
Support the implementation of the internal audit assurance framework, developing continuous monitoring routines for high-volume financial data and automated audit routines.
Build and support a strong and self-sufficient internal audit team.
Monitor the implementation of Internal Audit recommendations by the business teams and measure the effectiveness of the improvements.
Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders, internally and externally.
The role is London based, but many of our teams are located across different office locations. You will travel as needed to meet your objectives.
A bit about you
You are a curious problem-solver who thrives in a dynamic environment. You are not afraid to take ownership of complex new areas - such as first-time audits of Tax or Liquidity models - and can solve problems with limited guidance.

You’re curious - you’re great at asking insightful questions to understand the real issues and deliver the right outcomes.
You are passionate about driving change, making improvements and helping stakeholders.

You’re a strong relationship builder across all levels of the business and externally. You manage and influence stakeholders with ease.
You are collaborative - you enjoy sharing your knowledge and upskilling others.

Relevant experience in assurance, risk, or control roles, ideally within Fintech, Banking, or Financial Services.

AIG::/job/London/Senior-Multinational-Cl.title: Senior Multinational Client Executive
AIG::/job/London/Senior-Multinational-Cl.text:
At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Senior Multinational Client Executive to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.
Make your mark in Multinational
AIG Multinational is an exciting business area within AIG that designs, implements and services bespoke multinational insurance solutions for our global customers, empowering our clients and broker partners to navigate complex cross-border risks with confidence and consistency. AIG Multinational professionals have the diverse skills and expertise necessary to deliver customized, compliant and seamless solutions that support our clients’ risk management objectives. You can work alongside a dynamic, multi-disciplinary team to explore and deliver new solutions to meet our customers’ global insurance needs.
External broker and client facing role managing an assigned portfolio of Tier 1 Multinational programs working in partnership with product underwriters and distribution. Subject matter expert in the structure, design and execution of complex Multinational captive fronting and indemnity programs. This role has global fronting authority and supports all major Multinational lines of business.
How you'll make an impact
Manage and oversee all aspects of the multinational service delivery for the assigned portfolio and be accountable for the multinational client experience. This would include:
The proactive management and oversight of all multinational service activities, coordinating communication and project management across all internal and external stakeholders throughout the program lifecycle.
Provide direction and guidance to all relevant stakeholders across Multinational Business Model and AIG Network to ensure appropriate design and effective delivery and service of assigned multinational programs.
Provide multinational technical expertise to underwriters to ensure a compliant program structure and design, and adherence to all local regulatory requirements.
Lead the promotion and adoption of the AIG Multinational End-to-End process, so that all parties understand and commit to roles, responsibilities and expected timelines, to provide an elevated service performance and deliver contract certainty.
Ensure Multinational service fee discipline by utilizing available tools.
Lead and manage the day-to-day service delivery across all assigned programs to ensure the timely issuance of accurate local policy and invoice documentation and meet agreed program Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Partner with Product Underwriters to manage the approval of facultative reinsurance panel participants and the collection of compliant reinsurance documentation for all assigned programs.
Engage with multinational claims to ensure timely development of multinational claims bulletins / protocols and support on ad hoc program enquiries.
Partner with underwriting to draft legal documentation for loss sensitive programs and obtain approval from AIG legal counsel.
Monitor performance and escalate where necessary to ensure all agreed Multinational service SLAs are being met.
Operate as the senior external service contact and – working in collaboration with Product Underwriters and Distribution - provide regular updates to the appointed broker (or client if direct) on program performance until fully implemented.
Manage and partner with Distribution to coordinate periodic client/program stewardship meetings to be conducted in alignment and collaboration with underwriting and distribution.
Manage and be accountable for all compliance elements of assigned portfolio of global fronting programs as documented within the Multinational Global Fronting Underwriting guidelines and per the dual signature model. This would include:
Accurate and timely submission of credit application and all associated program information required to complete credit analysis and obtain approval.
Engagement with underwriting and AIG legal to ensure compliant reinsurance documentation is in-force, fully executed and held on file.
Completion of Risk Transfer Validations (RTVs) and binding status in Credit Risk Database (CRDB).
Work in partnership with credit and collateral management group to ensure the timely collection of all required security and collateral per agreed credit terms.
Accountable for the coordination and completion of all High Limit Referrals and continuing engagement with MN Chief Underwriting Office (CUO) if clarifications required for granting of approval.
Engagement with AIG’s reinsurance division/stakeholders to ensure monitoring of losses and the collection of any additional security or collateral as required by credit and per the terms of the in-force captive reinsurance agreement.
Monitoring of exposure on assigned portfolio to ensure the proactive engagement with relevant stakeholders and the collection of compliant security to mitigate year-end statutory penalties, per MN CUO guidelines.
Manage and oversee cash-flow to captives, working with collections and reinsurance division to ensure agreed SLAs are being met.
Completion of Peer Reviews for assigned portfolio.
General:
Drive the profitable growth of the Multinational global fronting portfolio by working with product and distribution to identify target opportunities and articulate AIG’s value proposition in the market.
Accountable for contributing to the development, qualification, prospecting and conversion of Multinational and Global Fronting Targets within assigned span of control.
Provide multinational subject matter expertise and be an escalation point to support colleagues in respect of multinational program design, territorial information and multinational related problem solving as required.
Help identify, support, and contribute to internal and external strategies that align our product offerings and grow AIG multinational business.
Represent AIG at external market events and provide broader support to multinational growth strategies, business development, thought leadership and training as appropriate.
What you'll need to succeed
Significant commercial insurance experience, preferably client servicing (broker or company background)
Strong technical knowledge of complex multinational programs, including reinsurance structures, with experience of the multinational environment and processes
Client focused with experience working with multinational corporations and dealing with senior client personnel / risk managers
Experience handling the structuring and execution of global fronting programs including captive and indemnity arrangements
Strong written & verbal communication and interpersonal skills
Computer literacy required: IT packages, MS Outlook, Excel, Word
At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.
Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters
At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.
Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world
American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.
Welcome to a culture of inclusion
We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. Knowledge and experience in various financial risk domains: valuation, sensitivities, market risk, counterparty risk, AVAs, XVAs.
Knowledge and/or experience in implementation of the Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB) regulation.
Minimum 5 five years of experience in project management, preferably in finance or banking.

Ability to analyze and understand quantitative models and valuation tools.
Sound technical knowledge of capital market products and acquaintance with financial risk systems and trading platforms.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Spanish and English . Spanish proficiency is not a must but a medium/high level acts as a plus to perform effectively in the role.
Ability to interact and negotiate with various stakeholders, including front-office teams, risk management, technology, and support functions.
Ability to work autonomously and proactively in a dynamic, constantly changing environment.
Strong ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and coordinate efforts across different areas.

Strong organizational and time management skills.
Problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
Results oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities and tight deadlines.
Flexibility and adaptability to manage projects with changing requirements.

Motivated to achieve ambitious organizational goals, maintaining strategic priorities to overcome challenges and obstacles.
Initiative to complete tasks and produce results effectively and efficiently.
Adaptability: effective performance in stressful environments under uncertainty, difficulty, and shifting priorities.
High capability to execute under tight deadlines and respond effectively to evolving requirements.
Innovation: ability to challenge established thinking by generating new ideas and maintaining an open-minded approach.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, capable of high-level analysis and proposing new solutions to challenges.
