BBVA Italy::/job/BBVA-One-Canada-Square-.title: Global Markets Risk Projects Execution - Senior Manager
BBVA Italy::/job/BBVA-One-Canada-Square-.location:
BBVA, One Canada Square (44th Floor), Canary Wharf
 London, E14 5AA (UK)
BBVA Italy::/job/BBVA-One-Canada-Square-.text:
Excited to grow your career?
BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. We are more than 121,000 professionals working in multidisciplinary teams with profiles as diverse as financiers, legal experts, data scientists, developers, engineers and designers.
The Global Markets Risk Unit (GMRU) is responsible for the measurement and monitoring of risk regarding Global Markets activities. The Risk Solutions team manages all the risk cycle comprising the design, execution and implementation of several risk-related projects, including valuation, market risk, counterparty risk, AVAs and XVAs, among others. The team also focuses on the implementation, development, and enhancement of corporate tools within the Global Markets environment, collaborating on projects started by either GMRU or other areas.
About the job:
Key Tasks and Responsibilities:
Act as the primary risk contact in the conception, planning, design, execution, and implementation of projects.
Define project scope from the outset, establishing the most suitable governance structure to ensure its success and securing the necessary approvals.
Understand the project scope and identify impacts across various risk dimensions, including valuation, market risk, counterparty risk, AVAs and XVAs, among others.
Ensure appropriate staffing for the project in coordination with relevant managers responsible for allocating resources .
Take responsibility for specific project-related actions and analyses when required.
Develop and maintain the project plan , manage unexpected events, dependencies, and define the critical path until completion.
Actively participate in project monitoring and execution committees, internally escalating relevant issues to discipline and/or process representatives.
Required Profile:
Studies in Engineering, Mathematics, Business Administration, or related.
Master’s Degree and/or FRM/CFA certifications highly valued.
Experience:
At least 8 years of professional experience in the financial or banking sector.
Knowledge and experience in various financial risk domains: valuation, sensitivities, market risk, counterparty risk, AVAs, XVAs.
Knowledge and/or experience in implementation of the Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB) regulation.
Proven experience in implementing and enhancing corporate tools within the Global Markets environment.
Knowledge and experience in programming, particularly Python, is highly valued.
Experience in the use of the Murex platform.
Experience using the Agile methodology.
Skills:
Ability to analyze and understand quantitative models and valuation tools.
Sound technical knowledge of capital market products and acquaintance with financial risk systems and trading platforms.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Spanish and English . Spanish proficiency is not a must but a medium/high level acts as a plus to perform effectively in the role.
Ability to interact and negotiate with various stakeholders, including front-office teams, risk management, technology, and support functions.
Ability to work autonomously and proactively in a dynamic, constantly changing environment.
Competencies:
Strong organizational and time management skills.
Problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
Results oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities and tight deadlines.
Flexibility and adaptability to manage projects with changing requirements.
Other Skills:
Motivated to achieve ambitious organizational goals, maintaining strategic priorities to overcome challenges and obstacles.
Initiative to complete tasks and produce results effectively and efficiently.
Adaptability: effective performance in stressful environments under uncertainty, difficulty, and shifting priorities.
High capability to execute under tight deadlines and respond effectively to evolving requirements.
Innovation: ability to challenge established thinking by generating new ideas and maintaining an open-minded approach.
Communication: ability to build smooth relationships with clients and suppliers, actively listen, and establish a network that facilitates tasks. Understanding user needs and integrating them with current and future technological platforms is critical.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, capable of high-level analysis and proposing new solutions to challenges.
Teamwork: ability to collaborate effectively, not only by seeking help and working as a team but also by sharing knowledge to ensure information flows inside the team.
Please note that priority will be given to candidates who are eligible to work in the UK.
Skills:
Client Orientation, Empathy, Ethics, Innovation, Proactive Thinking

Howden::/job/London/Assistant-Hospitalit.title: Assistant Hospitality Manager
Howden::/job/London/Assistant-Hospitalit.text:
Who are we?
Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.
People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.
We are hiring for an Assistant Hospitality manager
Who are we? Howden is a collective – a group of talented and passionate people all around the world. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mind-set, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 20,000 employees spanning over 100 countries.
Our people are our biggest asset as well as our largest shareholder group and are everything that makes us unique; our inclusive culture, the quality service we offer our clients, and our continued growth, all come from our people-first approach. There’s no such thing as individual success. We all need to play our part, contributing our skills and experience to make a true difference. That’s Howden.
Why work at Howden? We have always been employee-owned and driven by entrepreneurial spirit. Right from the beginning, we've focused on employing talented individuals and empowering them to make a real difference to the company, whilst building successful and fulfilling careers at the same time. Simply put, we hire talented specialists and give them what they need to make a difference for clients. Always have, always will.
People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down disappointed head-hunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work/life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.
What is the role? The Assistant Hospitality Manager will support the Head of Hospitality with the day-to-day delivery of hospitality services across internal and executive floors.
Working closely with the Hospitality Coordinator and Hospitality Assistants, the role will help maintain high service standards, effective team coordination and a consistently professional guest experience.
The Assistant Manager will provide visible operational leadership, resolve day-to-day service issues and deputise for the Head of Hospitality when required.
What will you be doing? Support the Head of Hospitality with the day-to-day operation of the Hospitality department, ensuring services run smoothly across all floors.
Provide visible operational leadership during service and act as a first point of contact for the Hospitality team.
Deputise for the Head of Hospitality during periods of absence.
Ensure hospitality services are delivered in line with standard operating procedures and agreed service levels.
undefined
Ensure the team offer all client guests refreshments and support for their meeting, regardless of which floor they are being served on
undefined
Manage the day to day performance and conduct of the hospitality team dealing quickly and professional with any issues that arise
undefined
Conduct monthly team meeting
undefined
Manage team briefings, and one-to-one conversations, ensuring constructive and timely feedback is provided to improve productivity
undefined
undefined
Assist with preparing staff rotas, and responding to short-notice changes in operational requirements.
undefined
Make sure unplanned absence are reported to Head of hospitality in a timely matter so adequate resourcing can be secured to meet business needs
undefined
Ensure employees are trained on appropriate customer service practices, uniformed and briefed
undefined
Support recruitment.
undefined
Manage onboarding, induction, and the ongoing development of team members.
undefined
Maintain accurate records for training, appraisals
undefined
Overseeing the delivery of refreshments, breakfasts, lunches to the required timings and presentation standards.
undefined
Support executive meetings and VIP guests with a discreet, professional and responsive service.
undefined
Manage the planning and delivery of fine dining lunches/ dinners and events, including last-minute requests and changes.
undefined
Work closely with the Reservations, Kitchen, Reception and Logistics to confirm event set-up, service timings, staffing, and equipment requirements.
undefined
Ensure daily and weekly menus are presented in the correct format and accurately display allergen and dietary information.
undefined
Work with the Head of Hospitality to contribute to service improvement initiatives
Promote compliance with food safety, hygiene, health and safety, and company policies and procedures.
Liaise with Boki staff and other service partners regarding day-to-day operational requirements.
Carry out any other reasonable duties requested by management.
Work flexibly, including early mornings, late evenings, and occasional weekends, to manage fine dining lunches and dinners, events and other business requirements.
What are we looking for? 3 years minimum experience as an assistant manager or supervisor within a corporate hospitality, hotel, restaurant or fine dining environment.
Proven experience managing a busy and demanding team, demonstrating confident and supportive leadership, with the ability to inspire, coach and motivate individuals while fostering a positive and high-performing team culture
Strong food and beverage service knowledge, with strong experience of manage fine dining / high-profile events.
Experience of coordinating shifts, allocating work and maintaining service coverage within a busy operation.
Excellent customer service skills and a professional approach when supporting executives, clients and VIP guests.
Clear communication and strong interpersonal skills, with the confidence to manage routine service issues.
Highly organised, proactive and attentive to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
The ability to remain calm under pressure and adapt quickly to changing business requirements.
Working knowledge of food hygiene, allergens, health and safety, and hospitality compliance standards.
What do we offer in return? A career that you define.
Our business succeeds by allowing our people to make a mark in the areas they care about most: personal development, volunteering, and fundraising for charity, or creating new insurance products that address society’s greatest challenges.
And we know that separate home and work lives don't really exist. If you're happy and healthy at home, you're more likely to be happy and fulfilled at work – and vice versa. That's why we do our best to support our people in every aspect of their lives.
Diversity and Inclusion At Howden we value diversity - there is no one Howden ‘personality type’. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
We support each other, in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
We are determined to make a positive difference, at work and beyond
We consider our people our chief competitive advantage and as such we treat colleagues, candidates, clients, and business partners with equality, fairness, and respect – regardless of age, disability, race, religion or belief, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, or family circumstances.
Our sustainability promise We’re on a life-long journey to become an ever-more sustainable group. It's a commitment to taking care of our people and the world we live in, to doing good business, and to making a positive impact wherever we can. Our governance processes, company policies, and review systems are all geared towards our goal of making a positive impact in the world. You can read more about our sustainability work here .
What do we offer in return?

Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

Reasonable adjustments
We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.
If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.
*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.

Wise::744000151348749.text:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
The CRM team is a diverse and inclusive crew of problem solvers from all over the world. We form long-term customer relationships through best-in-class communications - so more customers use Wise more often for their international money needs, stay with us longer, and advocate for us sooner. We place the customer at the heart of everything we do so they look forward to our communications because they’ll either be entertained, learn something new or find out about a useful product, service or promotion.
The team is structured into a Global team centered around our four main customer actions—Send, Hold, Receive, Spend & Grow, and a Regional team split by our key markets in the UK, Europe, North America, Latin America & APAC. So you’ll join a team of CRM specialists identifying regional opportunities to drive product adoption and improve retention, ensuring our lifecycle and adhoc comms are relevant and drive real impact in the UK and Europe.
The Role
We're seeking a versatile CRM Manager in London to help us drive our global B2C lifecycle communications strategy and implementation for the UK & Europe markets. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to shape and execute innovative campaigns, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and make a tangible impact on our customers' experience.
Develop and manage our UK & Europe CRM strategy, including customer lifecycle management, segmentation and engagement initiatives
Utilise data and insights to segment customers effectively and tailor communications for maximum relevance and impact
Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Creative, Engineering & Analytics teams to ensure alignment and seamless execution across multiple channels (email, push notifications, in-product messages)
Manage internal stakeholder communication and collaboration across various departments
Design and implement effective customer lifecycle management strategies to drive long-term engagement and loyalty through continuous optimisation
Analyse campaign performance and use data to identify and implement opportunities for increasing engagement and conversion rates at all stages of the customer’s lifecycle journey
Ensure compliance with CRM best practices and regulatory requirements while maintaining database health and retention efforts.
Implement the localisation process for Wise’s international campaigns
Oversee email calendar management, deliverability, and monthly reporting.
Mid-level experience in B2C CRM with a focus on segmentation, lifecycle management, and stakeholder engagement.Proven track record of successful cross-channel lifecycle communications.
Experience in end-to-end planning, development, and execution of large-scale engaging campaigns.
Customer-first attitude with a deep understanding of segmentation and customer needs.
Comfortable communicating and collaborating with stakeholders at all levels and from different departments.
Self-starter with a passion for taking ownership of projects and driving impact.
Technically savvy with a creative eye for design and messaging.
Strong analytical skills and a passion for leveraging data to drive performance.
Comfortable creating and running complex and impact-driven A/B testing plans.
Ideally proficient in using Braze or similar ESPs

Wise::744000151353199.text:

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
Role Overview:
Enterprise Risk Analytics at Wise is a critical capability. As we scale, the requirements for data-driven risk management are evolving. We need a talented Analytics Director to build and own our measurement frameworks, infrastructure, and reporting, ensuring audit-ready reporting and shared 1st/2nd line data governance. This role is highly strategic, focused on enabling the business to measure and manage risk across the full spectrum of major fintech risk domains.
What you’ll be doing:
Lead the strategy and execution of the Enterprise Risk Analytics roadmap while coaching a high-performing team.
Standardise risk metric calculation logic, KRIs/KPIs, and attribution logic while implementing sign-off processes to ensure data integrity.
Partner with Data/Engineering to align instrumentation and data models with risk monitoring needs, ensuring reliable pipelines with clear data lineage.
Drive insight-to-action loops, quantifying trade-offs between risk reduction, customer impact, and cost.
Establish shared governance cadences (metric councils, steering groups) and foster 1st/2nd line collaboration to prevent drift across lines of defence.
Provide analytics leadership for Financial, Fincrime, Ops, Resilience, and Reg stakeholders.
Who you are:
Proven analytics leadership in a scaled fintech, financial services, or regulated technology environment (3-7 years management experience).
Familiarity with control frameworks and LoD models, and how analytics supports assurance and oversight.
Demonstrated ability to build cross-domain measurement and reporting, including governance and audit/evidence expectations.
Strong stakeholder leadership: able to align and deliver through complex, matrixed organisations—especially across 1st and 2nd line.
Experience with risk quantification approaches (scenario drivers, stress-style thinking, trade-off modelling).
Track record building durable analytics foundations (pipelines, metric layers, monitoring/quality controls, operating rhythms).
High bar for metric integrity, clarity of narrative, and decision-making discipline.
Desirable:
Experience with operational resilience and/or technology reliability analytics (incidents, availability, recovery metrics).
Some important stuff we would like you to know:
To meet our regulatory obligations as a licensed financial services company, Wise needs to conduct background checks on all new hires, which in the Finance team includes Criminal and Credit checks. Please discuss with the Recruiter if you have any concerns regarding this process.
What do we offer:
Salary: £135K - £190K.
Company Restricted Stock Units.
Numerous great benefits in our London office .
Key benefits:
Hybrid working.
Paid annual holiday, sick days, parental leave and other leave opportunities.
6 weeks of paid sabbatical after 4 years at Wise on top of annual leave.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
We're looking for an Engineering Lead to join the Account Management team. This team is building the Current Account and Everyday banking experience products, which sit at the heart of Wise. The team owns how customers hold, organise and move their money day to day - their main account and Jars, the home screen they open, the flows they use to move, convert and add funds - and the ledger and money-movement systems underneath that the rest of the company builds on top of. Our mission is to make Wise the account customers reach for every day, and ultimately the last account they'll need to open.
The role spans engineering, product and people. You'll go broad across all three rather than deep in any one. You'll guide the team, own where it takes its systems technically, and partner with your Product Manager and Design to ship what customers rely on - staying close enough to the code to make sound architectural calls and unblock the team when it matters.
What you'll be doing
Lead the team's engineers - own what they ship and their well-being, and build a clear view of how to grow each of them.
Stay hands-on: write code, review designs and PRs, and drive whole features across backend, web and mobile, coordinating delivery across all three.
Own the team's technical roadmap. Decide how the systems evolve, keep reliability and tech-debt risk in check, and make the architectural calls that matter.
Partner with your PM and Design, and give sharp feedback on what's worth building and why.
Work across boundaries with the teams we build alongside: Account Sharing on joint accounts, Send on how money moves in and out, Wise Platform on products they build on top of account.
What you'll need to succeed.
We don’t expect candidates to tick all the boxes. If you have most of the below and want to grow into the rest, we'd love to hear from you.
Technical
Strong backend engineering background, close to the code to guide senior engineers through hard problems.
Deep understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures and microservices, and comfort making high-impact architectural decisions.
Track record of owning the reliability, scalability and correctness of critical systems at scale.
Comfortable in a JVM codebase, or confident you'll get there fast - we're on Java/Kotlin and Spring Boot.
Leadership
Experience leading a team of engineers and owning what they deliver.
Leadership through trust: you give people context and direction and let them own their work.
A clear communicator who can hold a technical argument with engineers and explain it plainly to everyone else.
Product
A product engineer’s mindset - you measure your work by customer and business impact.
Bias to action and comfort with ambiguity: you move quickly without dropping quality.
Nice to have
You use AI to build faster, and you're curious where it's heading.
You've worked in fintech, payments or banking.

Wise::744000151378909.title: Group Compliance Lead - Regional Platform
Wise::744000151378909.text:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
This is a first-line product compliance role. You will work directly alongside engineers and product managers to translate regulatory obligations into product decisions that are scalable, defensible and globally consistent.
Your mission
Keeping pace with how money moves. As Wise expands into new markets, corridors, and payment schemes, the rules governing how transfers are processed, and who can send them, become increasingly complex. You will own the compliance strategy for core product flows that determine customer eligibility: how we verify where customers live, how we handle customers who move between countries, and how we allocate customers to the right licensed entity. These aren't abstract compliance questions, they manifest directly in product screens, data models, and engineering decisions. You will need to go deep quickly, surface the "so what," and drive alignment between legal, product, and engineering teams across multiple markets.
Strengthening the infrastructure for regulatory accountability. Wise is continuously evolving the regulatory infrastructure that helps us demonstrate compliance across our licences, markets, and products. This platform connects our regulatory obligations to the policies, controls, … You'll help shape and strengthen this capability by partnering with engineers, product teams, and compliance specialists to ensure regulatory obligations are accurately reflected in our systems and translated into appropriate controls. You’ll also help make this scalable.
Staying ahead of global payment standards. Wise operates across dozens of payment schemes and licensed entities worldwide. As international standards for payment messaging and data requirements evolve, you will own the compliance thread for how Wise's product and data infrastructure keeps pace, working closely with data engineering, scheme specialists, and regional legal counsel to ensure our payment flows are accurate, complete, and consistently applied across every market we operate in.
As Group Product Compliance Lead, you will:
Own compliance strategy and delivery across all of Wise for core domains such as payment processing, obligations to control mapping and verification standards
Translate complex, multi-jurisdictional obligations into actionable product and engineering decisions
Represent Wise's compliance position to regional regulators, internal forums, and external auditors where required
Build relationships with product, policy, and compliance teams globally to maintain a consistent and current view of obligations across markets
Help define and scale the assurance frameworks that give Wise confidence its controls are working
We are looking for someone who:
Has deep fintech compliance experience, with a track record of working directly in product teams, not alongside them
Is comfortable in codebases, engineering discussions, and architecture reviews; not intimidated by technical complexity
Can move between regulatory text and product specifications without losing either thread
Is a strong communicator who can synthesise regulatory complexity into a clear position for non-specialists
Is comfortable operating in ambiguity; capable of defining structure where none exists yet
Has a track record of influencing decisions across legal, engineering, and product at senior levels
Has familiarity with payment scheme rules (SEPA, SWIFT, domestic real-time rails)
Has experience with multi-entity or multi-licence compliance structures
Has working knowledge of KYC and identity verification frameworks and the product decisions that flow from them
In return, this role offers:
Real ownership: you ship things, you don't just advise
No regional or domain siloing; genuine cross-functional ownership spanning product, engineering, and compliance
The chance to shape infrastructure and frameworks that will operate at company scale, affecting every Wise customer and licensed entity
An exceptional cross-functional team across product, engineering, compliance, risk, and banking

Wise::744000151415509.title: Senior ML Engineering Lead - Financial Crime
Wise::744000151415509.text:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
About the role:
Wise protects millions of customers and billions in transactions from fraud, money laundering and financial crime. Our ML systems are the front line of defense - operating at a global scale of 100K requests/minute under strict sub-50ms latency SLAs. We need an exceptional technical leader to own how these models are engineered, shipped and scaled.
We're hiring a Senior ML Engineering Lead to build and grow Wise's Risk Modelling engineering pillar. You will own the full model lifecycle standard for financial crime detection - from offline experimentation to production deployment and real-time monitoring and build the team to execute it. Your job is to build the automated engineering ecosystem and organisation that scales this safely to hundreds of models.
This is a rare greenfield leadership role with strong investment and engagement from Wise's CTO and senior leadership.
How we work:
Risk ML sits within Wise's FinCrime organisation, owning the full ML and AI foundation for financial crime detection. We're have three dedicated pillars - Feature Platform, Learning Loop and Risk Modelling. You'll lead the Risk Modelling pillar, leading a team of Senior ML Systems Engineers and Applied ML Engineers.
We operate with high autonomy and low hierarchy. You'll own the engineering strategy end-to-end - from architecture decisions and infrastructure design through to hiring, team culture and cross-platform partnerships. We value leaders who shape direction and build teams, not just manage delivery.
What will you be working on?:
The Model Factory: Architect the declarative pipeline that turns a configuration file into a deployed, monitored model - the engineering backbone for scaling to hundreds of models
The Experimentation Engine: Establish the reusable path from research (partnering with DS Research) to high-throughput production for traditional and modern architectures
Model Operations: Build the infrastructure for automated retraining, drift detection, threshold simulation/management and audit trails - the operational layer required to run hundreds of models safely at scale
The Team: Recruit, lead and mentor a world-class team of ML engineers. Establish a high-performance, engineering-first culture from scratch - setting hiring standards, technical bar and growth paths
Cross-Platform Partnership: Define and navigate the partnership with key platform teams - owning the build vs consume decisions for your pillar
What do you need?:
You've explicitly led or built an ML Engineering or model lifecycle automation team (not just used one) at a high-growth company - you defined the standards that other engineering teams followed
System-level and mathematical depth: you can design a model factory architecture, review a training pipeline & debug a runtime inference latency regression
Experience in high-throughput environments where latency constraints are tight and model failures carry massive financial consequences
Track record of hiring and developing senior engineers - you've built a team, not just inherited one
Ability to navigate ambiguity and make architecture-level decisions with incomplete information - this is a greenfield build, not an optimisation role
Strong enough technically to guide and review across deep learning, ML systems and production infrastructure - you lead through depth, not just delegation
Nice to Have:
Experience at a tier-1 fintech or payments company
Experience with graph-based methods (GNNs, entity resolution) in production
Foundation model fine-tuning or LLM evaluation experience
Experience establishing ML engineering practices in organisations transitioning from classical ML to deep learning

Wise::744000151434330.title: Senior/Staff Product Engineer - Risk & Control Governance
Wise::744000151434330.text:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Engineer to join the Risk & Control Governance team / Risk Assessment Group. You'll be instrumental in building the governance, assurance, and data foundations that ensure every risk decision at Wise is consistent, explainable, auditable, and continuously monitored.
This role works at the intersection of the Risk API platform, Product, and Financial Crime (FinCrime) teams — offering a unique opportunity to build the systems that give Wise confidence in every risk assessment it operates at scale.
You will be the driving force behind the platform's trustworthiness and integrity, focusing on:
Data Governance: Building and maintaining data ownership, lineage, and quality monitoring systems that ensure every risk decision is powered by trusted data.
Control Assurance: Designing continuous monitoring and validation systems that verify controls perform as intended — including trigger validation, drift detection, coverage analysis, and control health scoring.
Auditability & Explainability: Implementing end-to-end audit trails, change history tracking, and explainability tooling that enables one-click regulatory evidence generation.
Scalable Solutions: Designing robust, high-throughput solutions that handle large volumes of data and can be quickly understood and scaled across multiple distinct risk domains.
What will you be working on?
You will join the team at a pivotal moment, with your contributions being immediately visible and critical to the success of the entire Risk Assessment platform's governance layer.
The core challenge for the team — and your immediate focus — is to build the assurance and governance foundations that the platform currently lacks, ensuring every control can answer: Was the right trigger used? Was the right data available? Was the right decision made? Is the control still effective?
Your immediate impact will be to:
Build Data Trust: Implement data quality monitoring, data contracts, and lineage tracking that give the organisation full traceability from risk decisions back to source data.
Deliver Continuous Assurance: Design and build automated monitoring systems that continuously validate control effectiveness — detecting drift, false positives/negatives, and coverage gaps before they become incidents.
Enable Auditability: Create audit trail infrastructure and explainability tooling that dramatically reduces the effort required for regulatory reporting and compliance evidence generation.
Integrate with Risk API: Work closely with the Risk API team to embed governance and assurance capabilities into the core platform, ensuring clean integration points and shared data contracts.
What do you need?
Strong Backend Engineering: Proven experience building high-throughput, data-intensive systems in Java. Hands-on expertise with Kafka, SQL and NoSQL databases, and designing for scale and reliability.
Data Engineering Aptitude: Experience with data quality frameworks, pipeline orchestration, or lineage tracking. You understand what it takes to make data trustworthy at scale.
Systems Thinking: Ability to reason about complex distributed systems, identify failure modes, and design solutions that are both robust and operationally simple.
Ownership & Autonomy: Comfortable operating with ambiguity, defining your own work from high-level objectives, and driving delivery end-to-end without close direction.
Collaborative Mindset: Ability to work effectively across team boundaries — particularly with the Risk API team, Product, and FinCrime stakeholders — to align on contracts, data models, and integration patterns.
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

Customer Relationship Manager
137115
Location: London

The opportunity:
We’re looking for a Customer Relationship Manager who can deliver customer service excellence and new business for large and complex commercial customers.
You’ll join our market leading Customer Team within Zurich Commercial Insurance, in London. If you’re looking to progress your career, we would like to hear from you!
Working at a senior and strategic level, you’ll be an instrumental in our strategy to develop and grow our portfolio of highly valued, large and complex customers. Closely aligned with our Property, Casualty and Specialties underwriting teams as well our global broking partners, this role is key in developing and strengthening new and existing customer relationships. Thinking creatively, and with a keen focus on innovation, you will drive the design and negotiation of multi-line, non-conventional cross class programs and seek solutions that differentiate our proposition.
Many of our employees work flexibly, including part-time, flexible hours, job share, an element of working from home or compressed hours. This is because we want the best people for our roles, and we recognise that sometimes those people aren’t available full-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you may need.
What will you be doing?
Develop deep and long-lasting relationships with customers and London Market brokers serving as their primary contact within Zurich Commercial Insurance UK.
Set and deliver on the strategic direction for your assigned customers and growth opportunities.
Establish and lead the Zurich team across Underwriting, Claims, Risk Engineering to bring the breadth of Zurich’s full suite of products and services to our customers.
Determine appetite, allocate responsibility & appoint necessary resource to deliver the customer solution.
Set attack and defence plans where we feel we can deliver a great proposition for our customers and lead each Deal Team on any opportunity.
Finalise the design and negotiation of each deal with Customers and Brokers and confirm terms within set time frames.
Support growth lines of business to develop business plans and opportunities.
Maintain a visible and effective presence with our London Market global brokers.
What are we looking for?
Strong customer focus, capable of building and strengthening lasting relationships.
Established London Market relationships with a desire to develop new strategic relationships.
Capable of inspiring, influencing and challenging individuals and teams, to deliver best in class propositions.
Aptitude for analysing risk, evaluating solutions, and setting a strategic direction with effective and balanced decision making.
Experience working with non-conventional program structures, alternative risk transfer, captives, and risk management solutions.
Highly capable communicator with strong interpersonal skills.
Who we are:
At Zurich, we aspire to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world and the best global insurer. Together we’re creating a brighter future for our customers, our people and our planet.
With over 55,000 employees in more than 170 countries, you’ll feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company who are a long-standing player in the insurance industry.
We’ve made a promise to each other and every employee; to focus on sustainable impact, to care about each other’s wellbeing, to use our diverse expertise to be curious and optimistic and to develop the skills needed for our future.
If you're interested in working in a dynamic and challenging environment for a company that recognises and rewards your creativity, initiatives and contributions - then Zurich could be just the place for you. Be part of something great.

At Zurich, our sense of community is strong and we’re particularly passionate about diversity and inclusion, which we’ve won numerous awards for. We want our people to bring the whole of themselves to work and ensure everybody is made to feel welcome, regardless of their background, beliefs or culture. We want our employees to reflect the diversity of our customers, and so are committed to treating all of our applicants fairly and with respect, irrespective of their actual or assumed background, disability or any other protected characteristic.
We’ve an environment that places a real importance on our people’s wellbeing from a physical, mental, social and financial perspective. We work with our wellbeing partners and industry experts to provide the best advice and access to a wealth of lifestyle support. We’re also committed to continuous improvement and we offer access to a comprehensive range of training and development opportunities.
We’re passionate about supporting employees to help others by getting involved in volunteering, charitable and community activity. Our charitable arm, Zurich Community Trust, is one of the longest-established corporate trusts in the UK. AIG::/job/London/Chief-of-Staff_JR260382.title: Chief of Staff
AIG::/job/London/Chief-of-Staff_JR260382.text:
At Talbot and AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as our Chief of Staff to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.
Make your mark in Talbot
Talbot operates within the Lloyd's Insurance Market through Syndicate 1183, Syndicate 2019, Syndicate 2478 and Syndicate 2479.
Part of AIG since 2018, Talbot is committed to working with brokers and clients to deliver industry leading solutions. It is headquartered in London with offices in New York and Singapore with more than 350 employees.
With an expert team of highly skilled and experienced underwriters and a balanced, geographically diverse portfolio of business, Talbot has earned a reputation as an industry leading insurance and reinsurance specialist.
Talbot writes a diversified portfolio including Crisis Management, Energy, Financial Lines, Marine, Political Risk, Property, Transport and Terrorism. Drawing on our deep industry expertise, Talbot develops tailored insurance solutions that address clients' evolving and often unique needs.
How you will create an impact
The Chief of Staff (CoS) will act as a strategic partner to the CEO, helping translate Talbot’s goals and objectives into focused execution, enabling the successful delivery of strategic, financial, operational and people plans. The role operates across Talbot and AIG to drive alignment, accelerate key priorities, improve leadership effectiveness and ensure the CEO and leadership team are focused on the decisions and initiatives that will have the greatest impact
They will be instrumental in enabling Talbot to deliver its business objectives across the AIG Group, effectively managing relationships with other stakeholders. They will also act in an advisory capacity to the CEO in matters relating to business management and leadership, strategy, communications, people management and financial planning. They will be providing thought leadership, generating ideas and driving initiatives to improve business performance and providing meaningful contributions towards resolution of day-to-day and ongoing management issues.
The position demands a high level of initiative and autonomy to add value, enable business growth, to take corrective action and institute new processes, projects and activities. With strong relationships across AIG, within the Lloyd’s corporation and across the Lloyd’s market, the CoS will influence outcomes at a strategic level.
Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities
CEO Leverage & Priorities
Act as a trusted thought partner and sounding board to the CEO. As a confidante, discussion partner and advisor to the CEO, this role will providing thought leadership; supporting creation of ideas and resolution of issues
Translate the CEO’s vision into clear priorities, decisions and actions.
Anticipate needs, identify risks and develop solutions for the CEO to consider
Responsible for preparing and briefing the CEO prior to external meetings and/or events including; drafting talking points, speeches, briefing notes or analysis.
Strategic Execution
Strategic Execution; turn strategic priorities into executable plans with clear owners, milestones and outcomes (leveraging project & programme management experience)
Identify blockers and drive resolution across the business.
Directly assist the CEO in all day to day operations, including a variety of complex tasks and ensure the activities are aligned to business goals and priorities. Streamlining these activities and helping to ensure the highest quality of delivery
Identify and drive opportunities for change across the business.
Leadership team effectiveness & organisational influence
Prepare the CEO and Leadership team for key meetings and decisions
Establish strong meeting rhythms, agendas and follow-up.
Support the CEO in managing the Leadership team’s effectiveness and dynamics
Ensure decisions are clearly communicated and acted upon
Plan, coordinate and lead meetings, prepare information, monitor status of action items.
Ensure leaders understand and remain focused on the most critical areas; challenges competing priorities and help to resolve where functions are pulling in different directions.
Bring the right leaders together to resolve cross-functional issues; surfacing disagreements and competing perspectives.
Structure discussions so the leadership team moves from debate to decision.
Communication & Stakeholder management
Act as an extension of the CEO when appropriate; credibly presenting to the leadership team or senior stakeholders as necessary.
Draft or shape key communications, presentations and Leadership materials ensure consistent messaging around priorities and values.
Manage relationships with senior stakeholders, partners or the Board where relevant.
Maintain interdepartmental working relationships; identify priorities and organize daily assignments.
Takes a lead in organizing/setting the agenda for corporate events and strategy off-sites as directed by the CEO and in collaboration with their Executive Assistant.
Business Planning Insight & Analysis
Research, compile, analyse and summarize data for special projects and/or reports; developing recommendations on strategic and operational matters as required
Anticipate, prioritize, and interpret business or operational challenges that may impede on the business objectives and recommend actions to address.
Liaise with other departments on issues needing the CEO’s feedback/recommendation and develop strong relationships across Talbot and AIG.
Provides insight, content creation and project management support to the wider leadership team as directed by the CEO.
Act as physical presence and representative of CEO’s office and acts as a key point of contact or referral for the CEO and their employees
Supports the CEO, CFO and other members of executive team to develop high quality business strategies and financial plans ensuring their alignment with short-term and long-term AIG business objectives
Works collaboratively with the CEO and members of the leadership teams to drive and monitor business performance and financial results consistent with the plan objectives.
What you’ll need to succeed
Extensive experience partnering closely with a CEO or Senior Executive with similar high profile positions.
Strong commercial and strategic acumen, with the ability to quickly understand business drivers
Strong experience facilitating senior leadership meetings, teams and driving decision-making
Deep knowledge and experience of delivering commercial impact within the insurance industry
Experience of leading complex, cross functional initiatives without direct authority.
Program / Project Management experience
Extremely strong stakeholder management and relationship building skills (internal & external)
Expert at influencing, building rapport, challenging and holding senior leaders and stakeholders accountable both verbally or in writing; brings people on the journey with them whilst creating clarity.
Experience operating effectively in fast paced, ambiguous and evolving environments – navigating conflict and difficult situations
Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information
Ability to deal with multiple priorities and deal with change in a proactive and positive manner
Creative problem solver and lateral thinker
Excellent oral and written communication skills
Ready to maximize your impact? We would love to hear from you.
#LI-AIG
At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.
Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters
At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.
Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world
American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.
Welcome to a culture of inclusion
We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.
AIG provides equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected categories.
AIG is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants and employees with disabilities. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation, please send an email to candidatecare@aig.com .

The Risk Business Partner sits within the Risk function and supports UK&I Retail and its central functions. Reporting to the Interim Head of Risk, this permanent UK-based role will build strong relationships across the business and help embed the Enterprise Risk Management Framework, giving stakeholders the practical guidance, constructive challenge and confidence they need to manage risk effectively.

Partner with stakeholders across UK&I Retail and its central functions to embed the Enterprise Risk Management Framework into business activity and decision-making
Provide practical, proportionate risk advice and communicate risk responsibilities clearly across the business
Support the development and application of risk appetite, monitor agreed metrics and help stakeholders address tolerance breaches
Lead and support risk and control assessments, agreeing proportionate actions to strengthen the control environment
Embed effective risk event reporting and support root-cause analysis to identify recurring themes and systemic issues
Challenge the business on policy coverage, implementation and adherence, including requests for exceptions and waivers
Design and coordinate stress and scenario testing, gather relevant data, challenge assumptions and review model outputs
Prepare clear risk information and reports for relevant boards, committees and senior stakeholders
Identify and monitor emerging risks, track remedial actions and support the effective management of agreed actions
Deliver risk training and awareness activity, manage assigned projects and contribute to wider change initiatives

Proven knowledge of risk management gained within a regulated environment
Experience applying or supporting enterprise risk management frameworks, risk appetite processes, risk assessments or control frameworks
Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated sector, with retail insurance experience desirable
Evidence of providing clear, practical advice and constructive challenge to business stakeholders
Experience supporting operational resilience, stress testing or scenario testing
Demonstrated ability to analyse risk information, identify themes and translate findings into proportionate actions
A track record of delivering projects or change activity while managing competing priorities
Experience building effective stakeholder relationships and supporting confidence in new or changing processes

Satispay::cf136320-cdec-4e3a-8305-09a004.text:
Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Milan office.
About us
Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.
That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.
Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.
Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.
What you'll be doing
As our Head of Brand, you'll own the creative and brand strategy end-to-end, bridging the gap between high-level storytelling and measurable business impact, ensuring our mission resonates across every touchpoint.
Here's what that looks like in practice:
Creative Production - Owning the production of creative assets, ensuring every output meets a consistently high bar of quality, craft, and brand consistency.
Brand Activation - Driving both ATL (TV, radio, OOH, print) and BTL/untraditional activations, bringing the brand to life in bold and memorable ways.
Social Media & Community - Steering our presence across existing Social media channels and new ones, while building an influencer strategy that extends our reach and relevance.
Brand Strategy & Insights - Shaping and safeguarding brand identity, and grounding decisions in research and listening, including surveys with both customers and non-customers.
Leadership & Team Rituals - Building and mentoring the team behind these pillars, establishing clear creative rituals (design reviews, sprints, feedback loops) and tools to ensure efficient, high-quality output.
Cross-functional Collaboration - Partnering closely with Growth and Product teams to align brand initiatives with acquisition goals, retention targets, and product launches.
Performance-Driven Branding - Defining and tracking KPIs for brand awareness and consideration, ensuring that even the most "creative" projects are data-informed and contribute to Satispay's overarching OKRs.
You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.
Who we're looking for
You'll take on one of the hardest challenges at our scale: defining Satispay's identity globally while ensuring our brand initiatives directly align with acquisition and retention goals — and building the creative team and rituals that stay ahead of it as we grow. We're not looking for a caretaker of an existing setup. We're looking for someone who has built or transformed a function, made hard calls under pressure, and can say "here's the decision, here's why, here's what happened."
10+ years of experience - Proven track record in brand management or creative direction, ideally within fast-growing tech companies or top-tier creative agencies.
Strong Technical & Visual Culture - Deep understanding of design systems, rebranding processes, and multi-channel campaign production (from social media to TV/OOH).
A "Hands-on" Leader - You love to lead by example. You're not just a "manager of resources" but someone who can get into the details of a layout or a script to ensure excellence.
Data-Informed Mindset - Ability to translate brand concepts into business objectives, utilizing KPIs and OKRs to measure impact and iterate quickly.
Exceptional Communicator - Fluent in English, with the ability to simplify complex brand visions for internal stakeholders and external audiences alike.
We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.
Why this is your place
This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.
Own outcomes that reach millions. Lead functions where the results show up directly in the experience of 6.5M+ people and the businesses they pay every day.
Operate in high-growth. You'll make high-stakes calls without waiting for perfect information, in an environment that changes fast as we launch and scale new products.
Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.
Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.
CareAbout: how we support your impact
We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:
❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.
⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.
🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.
👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
*We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.
Initial salary: Starting from €65,000 gross per annum
This baseline is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role's core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value.
Equal opportunity employer
At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.
Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!
Learn more about us

Role details
Deal Strategist
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
Global Business Services’ (GBS) primary goal is to ensure operational excellence across deal cycles, increase revenue through the development of transformative commercial constructs, and drive closure of Stripe’s sold portfolio. The team's reach is widespread across Stripe, not exclusive to one sales segment or geographical region. GBS drives change across go-to-market, positively impacting Stripe users and cross-functional teams. GBS priorities are set through the direction of Stripe leadership and executive vision, partnership with sales and cross-functional organizations, as well as user feedback and market insights.
What you’ll do
The Global Business Services (GBS) team is looking for a Deal Strategist to focus on the closure of custom and standard commercial deals. You'll be responsible for deal lifecycle management and supporting cross-organizational alignment. This role requires a background in driving custom commercial and pricing deals to closure, a strong understanding of private pricing frameworks, as well as experience supporting sales through negotiations.
You will have experience with subscription products, pricing strategies, and a background in supporting selling motions. You have strong communication skills. You'll love this job if you are a natural relationship and mechanism builder.
Responsibilities
Manage end-to-end customer deals —drafting, editing, and reviewing agreements—while supporting the sales cycle to ensure deal terms align with business goals, reflect strategic priorities, and close as forecasted.
Act as the primary point of contact between Sales, Legal, and other cross-functional stakeholders for deal-related questions, approvals, and escalations.
Work directly with sales teams, sales leaders, services/support teams and customers to advise on deal structures, establish compelling commercials, and drive closure of customer issues.
Understand the business and technical requirements of our customers and partners, advising sales teams on the best approach (balancing risk between custom terms and internal system limitations).
Remove internal blockers and drive solutions between cross-functional teams such as Product, Legal, Finance, Accounting, Service Teams, etc.
Support complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial and legal agreements.
Support the pricing and structuring of multithreaded product use cases in all segments and industries especially in highly competitive sales.
Quickly build credibility and trust with internal customers.
Provide strong support, communication, and persuasion skills including XFN and senior leaders.
Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements
BA/BS degree in Business, Technology, Finance, or Economics with 8+ years of experience in deal management, procurement, pricing strategy, or financial consulting
Experience working in ambiguous, quickly scaling environments, comfortable with high-agency
Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and project management skills
Experience working in Payments and SaaS, and redlining agreements
Experience in Salesforce and Ironclad
Preferred qualifications
AI fluency and passion for applying emerging technology efficiencies in the day-to-day
Experience training or enabling sales teams on pricing, quoting, and contract best practices
In-office expectations
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
Pay and benefits
The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is £81,900 - £122,900. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.
Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.
We look forward to hearing from you.
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
Apply now

Visa::/job/GB---London-United-Kingdom/Di.title: Director, Rules Governance and Transformation
Visa::/job/GB---London-United-Kingdom/Di.text:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Job Description
The Ecosystem Program Transformation & Automation (EPTA) function within Payment Ecosystem Risk & Controls (PERC) drives the modernization, scalability, and effectiveness of Visa’s global risk programs. The team focuses on transforming how risk programs are designed, governed, operationalized, and enabled through technology, automation, and data‑led insights to protect the integrity of the payment ecosystem, strengthen trust, and enable secure growth by helping evolve risk programs and processes across regions.
Visa Rules are mandatory operating standards and enforcement requirements that govern how participants in the Visa payment ecosystem conduct business. They define rights, responsibilities, prohibitions, and consequences to protect the integrity, security, and reliability of the network. The Visa Rules Self‑Assessment (VRSA) framework is an important initiative that provides a standardized approach for assessing Visa Rules to ensure they remain fit for purpose, aligned with Visa's strategy, and supported by effective compliance and enforcement mechanisms. It enables Visa to proactively identify opportunities to strengthen governance, simplify requirements, address compliance gaps, and improve the overall effectiveness of the Rules framework.
This leadership role is accountable for the strategic direction, governance, operational effectiveness, and continuous evolution of Visa Rules Self-Assessment (VRSA), ensuring that Visa Rules remain fit for purpose and aligned with Visa's business, risk, compliance, and ecosystem objectives. This role provides enterprise-wide leadership to strengthen Visa Rules governance, drive operational excellence, improve consistency of decision-making, and enable scalable transformation through process, data, automation, and emerging technologies. The role will also be responsible for building a scalable future-state operating model and automation readiness across Ecosystem Program Transformation & Automation (EPTA) and Payment Ecosystem Risk & Controls (PERC) initiatives.
This role is critical to ensure:
Visa Rules requirements remain clear, enforceable, and aligned with strategic objectives.
Governance, risk, operations, and technology remain effectively aligned across an increasingly complex ecosystem.
Automation and AI-enabled capabilities are deployed responsibly and transitioned successfully into business-as-usual operations.
This role includes people leadership responsibilities, overseeing and developing a small, high‑impact team and guiding delivery in support of Visa’s strategic and operational objectives.
Key Responsibilities
In partnership with Senior Director, define strategy, target outcomes and roadmap for Visa Rules Self-Assessment (VRSA). Drive socialization, alignment and end‑to‑end execution, including executive readouts and addressing questions.
Act as a liaison between senior stakeholders, rule owners, PERC and EPTA leadership and manage trade-offs and escalations.
Support and evolve Visa Rules inquiries ensuring efficient and high-quality responses as well as defined escalation paths for resolution of complex inquiries.
Develop and present executive communication with clear, concise insights on VRSA outcomes and trends, process improvement impacts and readiness of automation and AI initiatives.
Drive continuous process improvement and operational excellence for VRSA, Rules Inquiries and adjacent EPTA workflows. Examples include playbooks, process artefacts, process flows, RACI, etc.
Support automation and AI initiative enablement, acting as a senior operational partner to EPTA and Technology teams. Drive alignment on governance and control expectations, support change management and adoption, enable the transition of solutions into BAU.
This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
Qualifications
10 years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree; or 8 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD)
Demonstrated experience leading and developing high-performing teams, including performance management and coaching
Strong interpersonal skills and proven abilities in negotiating and inﬂuencing internal and external clients
Strong written and verbal communications skills, ability to convey complex topics in an audience-centric way
Strong analytical aptitude and experience leveraging data, analytics, and performance metrics to drive business decisions, operational improvements, and transformation initiatives.
Experience leading business transformation, operating model improvement, or technology-enabled change initiatives managing complex stakeholder environments, and drive alignment across multiple functions or regions.
Proven ability to lead complex, cross‑functional initiatives, balancing competing priorities across regions and stakeholders
Experience gathering business requirements and translating needs into successful deliverables
Ability to effectively work under pressure and adhering to tight deadlines
Great time management skills, ability to set priorities and manage expectations, and work both as part of a team and independently
Visa experience or in-depth knowledge of the payment solutions industry is highly desired – including but not limited to Card Payments, ACH or Push Payments and knowledge of the Visa Rules highly desired
Experience with AI tools is a great plus
Personal Characteristics
Possesses a growth mindset and is eager to take on new challenges
Strong ownership, accountability, and resilience while navigating ambiguity and competing priorities, comfortable adapting to change and different environments
Focus towards action and overcoming barriers and finding solutions
Good judgment – ability to operate independently and knowing when / how much to involve leadership
Decisive with ability to balance big picture and details in decision making
Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
