More about our mission and what we offer .
At Wise, we're on a mission to build money without borders — instant, convenient, transparent, and eventually free. For businesses, that journey begins with verification (KYC), and getting it right is one of the highest-leverage things we do: every business we verify smoothly gets faster access to the financial services they need to grow, and every decision we make well keeps the financial system safer for everyone who relies on it — a small business getting paid on time, a migrant worker sending money home, a nonprofit moving funds across borders. There's a less visible side of this too: money launderers, fraudsters, sanctioned entities and organised crime networks actively try to exploit these same rails, and the harm they cause lands hardest on the people with the fewest defences against it. Getting Business KYC right is how we keep the door open for the first group and quietly close it on the second — and in this role, you'll be directly shaping that, globally.
We're looking for an Engineering Lead to manage the Platform team within the Business Onboarding Verification (BOV) organisation — based in London . This team owns the platform rails that Business verification is built on; the sister team (BOV Global) uses those rails to ship customer-facing journeys and agent tooling. There are three organisations in the wider squad — Business Onboarding Verification , Personal Onboarding Verification , and Wise Platform Verification .
The scale we operate at
In FY2025, 15.6M people and businesses used Wise; we onboarded over 5.9M new customers (~500K/month) and moved £145B across borders (~£400M/day) across 160+ countries and 40+ currencies .
Our onboarding decisions gate ~£25B/year in cross-currency volume.
Verification is on the critical path for every new signup and for ~10 product teams across Wise that build on our rails today.
Our verification systems are not supporting tools — they are core production infrastructure that protects customers, enables growth, and must stay reliable under constant change in regulations, policies and evolving threat patterns.
The team you'll lead - Verification Platform
You will lead the Verification Platform (under BOV) team in London — a cross-functional engineering team whose mission is to provide the BOV platform (Onboarding Platform for business, requirement evaluation, collection, review, unified vendor integrations, repapering rails) that lets BoV Global and regional teams iterate safely and quickly on business verification without rebuilding plumbing . Concretely, this team owns three work-streams:
Onboarding Platform (for business) — modelling Business requirements as configuration-as-a-service, per legal-entity type (Ltd, LLC, Sole Trader, Partnership, Corp), with versioned rules and repapering / refresh rails so a policy change is a config choice, not a multi-quarter project.
Review tooling platform — the review surface on which Global (and regional teams) build their review flows; the foundation that makes AI-assisted review and review automation measurable and safe to roll out.
Unified Vendor Integrations — one observable, retryable, swappable gateway for registry, adverse media, website signal, Acceptable Use Policy and Business Onboarding data vendors, replacing today's point-to-point integrations.
Your mission
As the Engineering Lead for BOV Platform, you will:
Lead, coach and mentor a cross-functional team of engineers — supporting their growth, well-being and performance, and empowering them to do their best work.
Own the technical roadmap for the BOV platform — make sure it addresses real reliability, security and scalability concerns of the Business verification stack.
Partner deeply with BOV Global, Personal Onboarding, Wise Platform Verification and Mitigation Handling so the platform serves real product needs — not what the platform team thinks the platform should be.
Be an active contributor to delivery. Support day-to-day execution, get hands-on when the team absolutely needs it, and stay in touch with the technology stack — leading by example.
Own the health and productivity of the team, fostering a culture of ownership, transparency, bottom-up decision-making, collaboration and continuous improvement — the way Wise engineering works.
Own operational excellence. Ensure appropriate on-call rotas, SLAs, documentation and observability for platform services; run incidents in your area of ownership and turn each into a durable fix.
Collaborate globally with engineering leads across Global KYC and Onboarding (London, Tallinn, Budapest and Hyderabad) and the wider Wise engineering community.
Run the engineering rituals of the team so we stay agile and predictable in product development.
Why this is an exciting problem
Picture a pharmaceutical company incorporated in Singapore, with one shareholder living in Dubai, trading in the UK and Singapore . In one signup, that business touches at least four regulatory perimeters — Singapore, UK, UAE for the shareholder, plus industry-specific controls for pharma (enhanced due diligence, sanctions, source-of-funds). Our job is to work out — in real time — exactly what each regulator needs, verify it against the right sources, and hand the customer a signup that feels effortless. Now scale that across 160+ countries and the millions of businesses we have. BOV Platform is building the framework that makes this possible without a new (or at most minimal) codebase per market, and the interesting problems stack up:
Configuration-driven, versioned rules at scale. How do we express "what KYC do we need for entity type × country × industry × partner × risk tier?" as data — hot-reloadable, auditable, and safe to change weekly — while giving regulators a clean audit trail of which version passed which customer ?
Distributed decisioning under real-world latency. A single verification decision fans out to 10+ internal services and external vendors (registry lookups, sanctions, PEP, document verification, ML models). Sagas, idempotency, timeouts, and graceful degradation all matter — because "we couldn't reach the sanctions provider" isn't an acceptable customer experience.
Consistency vs. availability on the KYC decision path. The same customer hits us from web, mobile and partner APIs concurrently. Where is strong consistency non-negotiable (a compliance-gated transfer) vs. eventual consistency fine (background re-screening)? How do we avoid decision drift across regions and entities?
Event-driven re-evaluation and repapering. Rules change; a country updates its policy; a customer's risk profile shifts. How do we re-decide retroactively across millions of customers without stampeding downstream systems or ops queues?
ML/AI in the loop — safely. Where does automation genuinely help (document classification, risk scoring, agent copilots), where does it not, and how do we ship it with safe fallbacks, clear observability and a human review path that doesn't become the bottleneck?
That's the problem your team will help solve — with real regulatory teeth, real customer impact, and enough platform surface area to keep senior engineers engaged for years.
A bit about you
You have proven experience leading and mentoring software engineers , including managing performance, well-being and growth, and handling difficult situations constructively (360 feedback, calibration, performance reviews).
You have built and led platform / infrastructure teams whose customers are other engineering teams — you know how to say no, how to prioritise for leverage, and how to keep a platform from turning into a bespoke-request queue.
You have solid Java (17+) knowledge and hands-on experience with Spring / Spring Boot , and you're happy to stay hands-on when the team needs it.
You have strong system-design skills with real experience of distributed, high-throughput, resilient services — event-driven architectures, sagas, idempotency, orchestration vs. choreography trade-offs.
You have experience working with relational and non-relational databases , query optimisation and schema design.
You have led the design and delivery of complex engineering solutions and understand their broader impact on business outcomes — including trade-offs between short-term product wins and long-term platform health.
You approach challenges with a strong product and customer mindset , prioritise customer needs (both external customers and the internal teams you serve), and make data-driven decisions.
You have excellent communication skills — you can articulate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences, and are comfortable working across geographies and time zones.
You show strong ownership and accountability , are able to operate beyond a purely technical scope, and act as an enabler for the extended team.
What you can expect as an Engineering Lead at Wise
We don't measure seniority by years of experience, but by the impact you create and the complexity of problems you help solve. You will experience leading a product engineering team first-hand — one of Wise's unique strengths. As an EL1 at Wise, you will:
Lead a cross-functional platform team, with a clear scale-up path as BOV Platform's remit grows (requirements, review platform, vendor gateway, repapering).
Own the technical roadmap and vision for your team and contribute to the product roadmap and vision for BOV.
Propose ideas to improve and grow the BOV platform; work with stakeholders (BOV Global, Personal Onboarding, Wise Platform, Mitigation Handling, Risk & Compliance) to build conviction to unblock opportunities.
Build strong relationships with the sister BOV Global crew and with the wider Global KYC and Onboarding squad across London, Tallinn, Budapest and Hyderabad.
Embrace long-term ownership of projects while training other engineers to reduce single points of failure; identify gaps and plan ahead for hiring.
Be active in architecting and designing services that allow for iterative delivery and future scaling — through feedback and reviews. Get hands-on when the team absolutely needs it, to stay in touch with the technology stack.
Collaborate closely with product, analytics, compliance and operations to ensure smooth and effective delivery.
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Howden::/job/London---One-Creechurch-Pla.text:
Who are we?
Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.
People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.
Please read before submitting: You may only apply to one graduate programme for our 2027 intake. Submitting duplicate applications will result in them not being considered.
Location: London
Start date: September 2027
Salary: £40,000
Working Pattern: Hybrid (3-4 days in the office)
Surety Graduate Programme
Be Part of the Deals Behind Major Global Projects
Are you interested in how major businesses win contracts, manage risk and deliver large-scale projects? Join Howden's Surety team and discover how surety helps businesses secure the guarantees they need to win contracts, deliver projects and fulfil important commitments. We work with clients, insurers and financial institutions to arrange solutions that support projects, investments and commercial agreements around the world.
As part of Howden's Capital, Advisory and Placement team, you'll gain exposure to finance, legal agreements, risk assessment and relationship management, all while working on real client projects from the start of your career.
You'll join Howden in a permanent role and complete our structured 18-month development programme, designed to build your technical expertise, commercial awareness, professional confidence and long-term career foundations.
What you’ll be doing?
You'll begin with a structured induction before joining the Surety team, where you'll work alongside experienced specialists supporting complex client transactions.
Learn about our surety products and the end-to-end process for placing surety bonds.
Work directly with clients and underwriters to structure and place surety bonds.
Review legal contracts and financial records to identify any risks that may make the surety bond too risky for an insurer.
Support with reviewing client documentation and preparing materials for upcoming meetings.
Assist with taking meeting notes to ensure that client files are accurate and up to date.
Gain early exposure to client and insurer meetings, learning how our clients are advised and how deals are negotiated.
Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external contacts.
Who are we looking for?
No insurance experience is needed; we’ll teach you everything you need to know!
You'll be:
A recent Law or Finance graduate, or in your final year of study and have a strong interest in commercial, legal, and financial matters.
Analytical and have meticulous attention to detail.
Confident to learn how to influence and negotiate in professional settings.
A strong communicator who enjoys building relationships and working with clients, colleagues and external partners.
Able to articulate your ideas well both in writing and verbally.
Comfortable speaking on the phone with senior individuals.
Resilient and hard-working and curious to learn and develop.
To be eligible for our programme, you must have the full and unrestricted right to work in the UK.
Application process
Our application process is designed to help you show your potential, not to test what you already know!
Online application form – no CV required: We believe you're more than just a document, so we won't ask you to submit a CV. Please upload a blank document on the application form.
Online gamified assessment: We’ve created games that will help us understand your natural strengths and how you approach different situations. There are no right or wrong answers. You can complete this stage on your phone or laptop, whichever suits you best!
Pre-recorded video interview: You will record your answers to a few questions using your phone or laptop, giving you the chance to tell us more about yourself in your own time in a relaxed setting.
Assessment centre: Our final stage is an in-person assessment centre at one of our offices. You'll take part in some fun group activities and meet our team in a relaxed setting. This day is all about getting to know you better and for you to see what it's like to be part of Howden and experience our culture. We'll cover all your travel costs for this day, because where you are now, shouldn’t hold back your future!
Why should you apply?
£40,000 salary and a generous pension scheme.
A permanent role from the day you join Howden.
Structured learning and development through our 18-month graduate development programme.
25 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays and an additional day off at Christmas.
Access to discounted personal health policies, wellbeing support and a range of employee benefits and insurance products.
2 days allocated to take part in volunteering schemes.
Explore our Connectr page to discover more about Howden, our culture, and the insurance industry. You'll find resources to help you prepare for our recruitment process and understand which career path could be the best fit for you.
Please read before submitting: You may only apply to one graduate programme for our 2027 intake. Submitting duplicate applications will result in additional applications not being considered.
What do we offer in return?
A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond
Reasonable adjustments
We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.
If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.
*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.
Permanent

Who we are

About the team
The Global Payment Methods and Expansion Partnerships team develops and manages relationships with payment methods and financial partners that enable Stripe’s product strategy, and delivers new capabilities in new and existing markets to Stripe users. This is not a traditional sales, channel, merchant-partnership, or account-management role. You will build product and infrastructure partnerships with banks, acquirers, payment providers, and other financial institutions that enable Stripe’s products and market launches. Our team executes on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives across new products, geographic expansion, user advocacy, and policy. These partnerships have a significant impact on Stripe and the products used by millions of our users.
What you’ll do
We are looking for a new member to join our team to develop and execute on high-impact initiatives with both payment method partners and expansion partners in new and existing markets, focussing on EMEA. These partnerships form the basis of Stripe’s product. As part of these efforts, you will be responsible for deal negotiation and execution for our EMEA payment methods and expansion business. This is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact and contribute to the growth and success of Stripe's payment method partners.
The role will require close coordination with product and engineering teams, as well as cross-functional stakeholders including go to market teams, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Risk, etc., and with external partners’ senior executives.
Responsibilities
Identify opportunities and craft partnership and product strategies for market expansion and payment method partners in existing markets in EMEA
Execute deals, manage partner onboarding and partnership development for new and existing financial partners
Understand our partners’ strategic priorities, challenges, and internal roadmaps; regularly communicate insights and recommendations to Stripe product stakeholders
Develop and grow Stripe’s relationships with partners, identifying partner stakeholders who will champion Stripe, and building alignment between Stripe and our partners
Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to measure the effectiveness of both deal processes and ongoing partner management and distribution initiatives
Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements
10+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, corporate development or a related field
5+ years of experience related to payments and/or ecommerce
Deep EMEA market knowledge, and a thorough understanding of payment method dynamics and business models
Strong agency, can handle ambiguity in a fast-moving organization, and thrives on a high level of autonomy and responsibility
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders with varying priorities and drive creative solutions and commitment to a shared goal
Experience working in a product centric environments with significant internal and external dependencies
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders internally and externally across a wide variety of functions
In-office expectations
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
Pay and benefits
The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is £117,300 - £175,900. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.
Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.
We look forward to hearing from you.
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Senior Client Data Management Project Manager
Are you passionate about translating strategy into measurable business impact? Join Swiss Re’s Client Data Management team within Life & Health Reinsurance, where you will collaborate with senior leaders and cross-functional teams across all regions to shape and deliver the next phase of our global client data agenda.
About the Role
As Senior Client Data Management Project Manager, you will have the overall responsibility for project delivery across the global Client Data Management agenda, from strategic framing through execution, change adoption and benefits realization.
Working closely with senior business sponsors, you will translate strategic direction and business priorities into executable plans, mobilize and engage cross-functional teams, manage dependencies and risks, and drive timely decisions.
This is hands-on delivery role where success means creating momentum, driving accountability and turning plans into outcomes. You will be equally comfortable setting the approach and driving the detail from facilitating senior-management discussions and governance forums to working directly with regional/functional teams to resolve issues and unblock delivery.
Current focus
Client data is increasingly important to decision-making and value creation across Life & Health Reinsurance providing a critical foundation for data-driven and AI-enabled capabilities. With strong foundations established, the focus is now on scaling our client data capabilities to meet growing demand for timely, trusted and reusable data.
In this role, you will be responsible for:
Project leadership: Translate strategic priorities into clear project scope, milestones, delivery plans and measurable outcomes. Provide overall delivery oversight across interdependent workstreams and regions.
Planning and prioritisation: Establish structured approaches to prioritisation and delivery planning including resource and capacity requirements.
Cross-functional delivery: Mobilize and coordinate business and technology delivery across the Life & Health value chain, actively managing dependencies, risks and issues to drive agreed outcomes.
Stakeholder management and governance: Partner closely with project sponsors, functional leaders and senior stakeholders to maintain alignment and enable timely decisions. Provide concise, decision-ready reporting on progress, risks, trade-offs and areas requiring management intervention.
Transformation and change: Drive the evolution of client data processes, governance, accountabilities and ways of working, translating future-state direction into practical change and implementation plans.
Resource and financial management: Work with functional and regional leaders to identify capacity and capability requirements, support resource and funding requests, and manage project financials.
About the Team
The Client Data Management team within Life & Health Reinsurance is a global team responsible for ensuring client data is acquired, validated, ingested and made available across the business. Our mission is to deliver trusted and timely client data that enables confident decisions and sustainable value for Life & Health.
About You
You combine strategic thinking with pragmatic execution, bringing structure and clarity to ambiguity while constructively challenging assumptions and influencing stakeholders across a global organization to drive outcomes.
You adapt your communication and leadership style across different audiences — from delivery teams to senior executives.
Required Experience:
7+ years of experience leading projects and change initiatives, preferably within (Re)insurance.
Strong end-to-end project management experience across business and technology, including planning, governance, risk and dependency management, resource planning and financial management.
Proven ability to translate strategic direction into execution, including shaping the approach where the path forward is not fully defined.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, working across functions, regions and seniority levels in a complex global organization.
Experience delivering data and business transformation, including organizational and operating model design and implementation.
Nice to have:
Experience in Life & Health (Re)insurance.
Experience with client data or data-driven business initiatives.
Project and change management certifications (e.g. PMP, PROSCI, Scrum)
For London, the base salary range for this position is between GBP 84'000 and GBP 126'000 for a full-time role. The specific salary offered considers:
the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.
In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.
Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Wise::744000151858969.title: Lead Marketing Analyst - Growth Enablement
Wise::744000151858969.text:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
We are looking for a strategically-minded Lead Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team. This role is centered on owning reporting and deepening our understanding of what actually drives marketing growth, while helping the wider team pursue the opportunities and gaps that matter most.
You'll focus on surfacing strategic opportunities from our Marketing Financials process and making them accessible for action across our analytics and marketing context. By using and streamlining emerging technologies and AI in the team, you will play an important role in the technical engine and processes that turn complex data into central resources, insights and clear prioritisation.
In this role, you'll spot the horizontal opportunities that don't surface within any single Marketing Analytics pillar, build the business case for the ones that matter, and hand them to the right team to execute. You won't own every initiative, but you'll be the one who sees the whole board and helps decide where the leverage is. You'll also shape how we operate as a wider team, defining and improving how we collaborate and prioritise.
You have the business acumen to know what makes a data product genuinely useful to marketing stakeholders at a strategic level and a real interest in enabling other analytics teams to pursue the opportunities you find. You'll keep data quality solid across a broad horizontal scope, building a clear, reflective view of past growth drivers while laying the foundation for future strategy, ideation, and understanding across the wider analytics team.
Your Mission
Your mission is to turn complex marketing data into a scalable engine for insights, growth driver explanation and strategic execution. You will own the technical set-up behind how we explain marketing performance, developing the automated tools (such as Streamlit apps, AI/agentic automation, and reporting tools) that make the drivers of our growth clear and easy to act on. You will further enhance productivity and prioritisation within the wider Marketing Analytics team leveraging these same technologies into effective and streamlined processes such as semantic layers, impact calculations and AI-skill alignment across teams.
Rather than just reporting the financials, you'll focus on the why to pinpoint the highest-value opportunities within our Marketing Financials process, working closely with the wider marketing, analytics, product, and regional teams to carry those opportunities through to execution and improvement. You'll also use your cross-team overview to strengthen how the wider Marketing Analytics team works, so that we prioritise, manage, and deliver initiatives effectively.
Key Responsibilities
Analytics Ownership
Growth Driver Explanation: Build and maintain the reporting, tooling and infrastructure to explain marketing growth drivers, ensuring the wider business clearly understands the mechanics and the why behind our performance.
Automating Insights: Lead the further productionising of our Marketing Financials process, shifting the focus towards automating driver analysis and providing deep-dives that uncover the core reasons behind growth performance.
Opportunity Identification & Enablement: Proactively identify key opportunities and gaps within the Marketing Financials process and drive these into execution with the wider Marketing Analytics-team and stakeholders.
Advanced Analytics Tools: Lead the development and deployment of advanced analytics consumption tools, including Lightdash reporting, Streamlit apps, and AI/agentic automation to provide clear, accessible explanations of growth drivers. Play a constructive role in streamlining usage of these tools across the wider Marketing Analytics team.
Impact-Driven Delivery: Balance technical rigor with speed to deliver meaningful data products that translate complex growth drivers into clear business impact.
Leadership & Partnering
Successfully collaborate with stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics and Regional teams, acting as the crucial bridge between identifying data-driven opportunities and executing them within the wider marketing context.
Be a subject matter expert on technical infrastructure within the Marketing Analytics team, ensuring our systems are optimized for driver analysis and explanation rather than just standard reporting.
Contribute to the overall analytics strategy, ensuring that tribe data and analytics are discoverable, leveraged, and heavily focused on actionable understanding.
Effective project management and communication skills, with the ability to inform multiple horizontal initiatives in parallel, sequence them by impact, and keep the right stakeholders aligned from identification through to execution.
Skilled at defining and improving ways of working across the wider Marketing Analytics team, establishing the practices and prioritisation frameworks that help multiple pillars collaborate efficiently and focus on the highest-impact work.
Required Qualifications
4+ years of hands-on experience in a marketing analytics, data engineering, or insights role, ideally at the start of your technical lead journey.
Strong proficiency in SQL and advanced Python is required.
Experience with modern data stacks, including dbt, data warehousing (e.g., Snowflake), and visualization/semantic layers like Lightdash or Looker.
Proven competencies in identifying analytical opportunities within financial/marketing processes and reporting on them effectively
Strong ability to understand the underlying mechanics of marketing to ensure technical products are meaningful and focused on explaining growth drivers.
A focus on building systems and automated insights that drive measurable improvements in how the business understands and acts upon data.
Experience and interest in project management, ways of working improvements and enabling wider teams in efficient collaboration.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building data products, such as Streamlit apps, custom internal tools such as JIRA, or AI-integrated workflows.
Familiarity with AI-native development workflows and tooling (e.g., Cursor, Claude, or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate the build of data products and automated agents.
Proven ability to automate context around data, creating technical systems that effectively communicate and explain the drivers of growth to a wide stakeholder set.

About the role
We’re looking for a Senior Platform Engineer (IC3 level) to join our Database Platform team. You’ll help build and operate a global platform that’s scalable, reliable, and secure - developing the internal database platform, automation, and tooling that powers hundreds of databases across multiple environments. You’ll work on high-scale systems used by hundreds of engineers, shaping how we run databases globally.
How we work:
We believe in automation, programmatic implementation, and reusable design. You’ll think holistically about the ecosystem, while also delivering real solutions - collaborating across the Platform tribe to make our systems more resilient and developer-friendly. At this, you help set and evolve technical standards, design patterns, and best practices for the platform.
As we scale, we need engineers who can simplify complex infrastructure, build guardrails, and deliver platforms that help product teams move fast - without compromising reliability or security. You proactively identify technical debt and plan remediation work to keep risk within appetite.
You’ll work closely with other Platform and Data teams to ensure best practices are followed and the right abstractions are in place. You provide strong technical input into product and platform roadmaps, explaining why work is prioritised and what impact it delivers.
You’ll be part of a team that empowers hundreds of developers to build reliable services faster, with modern tooling and infrastructure at scale. The systems you design will directly impact the availability, performance, and safety of our customers’ data worldwide. You’ll join a collaborative team that values technical excellence, learning, and continuous improvement.
At this, you are a recognised technical leader, shaping both the platform’s direction and the engineers around you
What will you be working on?:
Design, build, and evolve our internal cloud-based database platform.
Lead these initiatives end-to-end, optimising for predictable delivery and measurable outcomes.
Define the long-term automation strategy, including migrations, upgrades, and failure recovery patterns.
Help embed security and compliance controls (encryption, auth, RBAC, network controls) into Yugabyte platform components.
Be accountable for the availability, reliability, and security of the systems you own.
Collaborate with product teams, SREs and DBAs to apply platform guardrails for services adopting database technologies.
Act as the escalation point for your area, leading minor and major incident resolution and post-incident reviews.
Mentor and coach other engineers, support onboarding, and actively reduce single points of failure.

Represent the team in cross-tribe or cross-company engineering efforts and guilds.

Essential

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
Product Operations is a small team of specialists at Wise. Our focus is the machine - the people, processes and practices - that builds our product. We work with autonomous product teams to help them move faster, stay aligned and build the right things for customers and partners.
Wise Platform is Wise’s infrastructure business. We work with banks, fintechs and global companies such as Monzo, Morgan Stanley and Google to embed Wise’s international money movement capabilities into the products their customers already use. That means Wise Platform teams solve both deep product infrastructure problems and practical partner problems: how to make cross-border money movement faster, simpler, more reliable and easier to scale through others.
You will act as the key Product Operations partner for Wise Platform. It is a complex, fast-growing area that brings together product, engineering, commercial, operations, compliance and partner-facing teams, so partners can build on Wise at scale.
In this brand new role and as the main point of contact for Wise Platform, you’ll be responsible for identifying and delivering ways to make Wise Platform product teams more effective. You’ll help teams improve how they plan, communicate, prioritise, learn from partners and measure progress. You’ll work closely with Wise Platform leadership and teams, while also connecting with other functions across Wise.
What this will involve:
Helping Wise Platform teams improve planning, prioritisation and follow-through, so product development is focused on the most important partner and customer problems.

Join us as a Credit Control Team Leader - 12 months FTC (Maternity Cover)
Make your mark in Talbot
Talbot operates within the Lloyd's Insurance Market through Syndicate 1183 and Syndicate 2019. With an expert team of highly skilled and experienced underwriters and a balanced, geographically diverse portfolio of business, Talbot has earned a reputation as an industry leading insurance specialist. Talbot writes a diversified portfolio including Crisis Management, Energy, Financial Lines, Marine, Political Risk, Property and Terrorism. Drawing on our deep industry expertise, Talbot develops tailored insurance solutions that address clients' evolving and often unique needs. Syndicate 2019 provides Lloyd’s investors with access to AIG’s Private Client Select (PCS) portfolio. Responsible for the day to day management of Credit Control Team

Who are we?
Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.
People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.
Role – Risk Associate – Risk Operations
Who are we?
Howden is a collective – a group of talented and passionate people all around the world. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mind-set, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 100 countries.
Our people are our biggest asset as well as our largest shareholder group and are everything that makes us unique; our inclusive culture, the quality service we offer our clients, and our continued growth, all come from our people-first approach. There’s no such thing as individual success. We all need to play our part, contributing our skills and experience to make a true difference. That’s Howden.
Why work at Howden?
We have always been employee-owned and driven by entrepreneurial spirit. Right from the beginning, we've focused on employing talented individuals and empowering them to make a real difference to the company, whilst building successful and fulfilling careers at the same time. Simply put, we hire talented specialists and give them what they need to make a difference for clients.
Always have, always will.
People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down disappointed head-hunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work/life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.
What is the role?
Based in our London office and reporting to the Senior Risk Manager, this role will focus on supporting the Senior Risk Manager within Risk Operations in keeping the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework live and effective across all pillars of the business. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining an accurate, up to date Risk and Control Register, contributing to meaningful risk output, and playing a key role in project management and ongoing governance matters such as the policy schedule and risk assessments.
What will you be doing?
Key Responsibilities:
Supporting the Senior Risk Manager in producing and communicating the annual ERM plan.
Manage assigned risk assessments and projects, contributing to others as required.
Support the ERM Team in reporting processes on key plans, projects, and initiatives, as well as managing stakeholder expectations and escalating issues and concerns promptly.
Direct and support the embedding of risk management activities across key change initiatives, including acquisitions.
Ensure the Risk and Control Register remains live and accurate.
Support Risk Business Partners across the organisation.
Support the production of high-quality risk management information and reports.
Assist with ongoing administrative tasks as needed.
What are we looking for?
Qualifications & Experience:
Strong analytical, written communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to identify risks, trends, root causes, and mitigations.
Solid understanding of risk management processes and frameworks.
Ability to engage effectively with multiple stakeholders across all levels.
Proficient in Microsoft Office: Outlook, PowerPoint and Excel.
Analytical and problem-solving capability.
What do we offer in return?
A career that you define.
Our business succeeds by allowing our people to make a mark in the areas they care about most: personal development, volunteering, and fundraising for charity, or creating new insurance products that address society’s greatest challenges.
And we know that separate home and work lives don't really exist. If you're happy and healthy at home, you're more likely to be happy and fulfilled at work – and vice versa. That's why we do our best to support our people in every aspect of their lives.
Diversity and Inclusion
At Howden we value diversity - there is no one Howden ‘personality type’. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
We support each other, in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
We are determined to make a positive difference, at work and beyond
We consider our people our chief competitive advantage and as such we treat colleagues, candidates, clients, and business partners with equality, fairness, and respect – regardless of age, disability, race, religion or belief, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, or family circumstances.
Our sustainability promise
We’re on a life-long journey to become an ever-more sustainable group. It's a commitment to taking care of our people and the world we live in, to doing good business, and to making a positive impact wherever we can. Our governance processes, company policies, and review systems are all geared towards our goal of making a positive impact in the world. You can read more about our sustainability work here .
What do we offer in return?
A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond
Reasonable adjustments
We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.
If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.
*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

For everyone, everywhere.

We’re looking for a Data Science Lead to lead and develop our growing Verification Data Science team within KYC Global and Onboarding in London.
This role is a unique opportunity to understand the customer KYC domain, how we mitigate risk leveraging data science techniques, and at the same time how to provide our customers with the seamless experience they deserve. What you build will have a direct impact on Wise’s mission and millions of our customers.
About the Role:
Our verification team is responsible for the processes related to KYC (Know Your Customer) checks performed on consumers and businesses during onboarding. Within the team, our data scientists implement machine learning models and systems that support Document verification.
We are looking for someone to own the team’s data science roadmap, lead and develop our data scientists, and take responsibility for the impact and quality of our machine learning systems. You’ll provide technical direction across the model lifecycle, from training and testing to production performance and further improvements to our KYC systems.
Here’s how you’ll be contributing:
Own the data science roadmap and prioritise projects in collaboration with cross-functional teams, aligning the team’s work with customer needs and business goals.
Actively participate in planning and ideation of data science projects in collaboration with integrated cross-functional teams
Uncover opportunities and provide expertise on applying machine learning/data science techniques
Clearly articulate the value, limitations, and potential impact of data science initiatives to stakeholders with diverse levels of understanding
Manage and create large image and tabular datasets related to KYC processes
Iterate on our deep learning image models
Measure and optimize performance of our machine learning models
Maintain and develop a large Python codebase with industry-standard best practices
Keep up-to-date with the rapidly developing field of machine learning and research how to incorporate new ideas on systems that benefit our customers directly in production
Research the domain of Document verification to learn the best ways to prevent criminal activity
Manage and develop data scientists through coaching, regular feedback and career support, setting clear expectations and supporting hiring as the team grows.

Wise::744000152174364.text:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
About the role:
Wise moves billions every month. Every single transfer runs through Send Experience.
We own the send flow end-to-end: the product millions of customers touch, the discovery layer that makes local payment networks like Pix and UP feel native, and the platform holding tens of millions of recipient accounts worldwide. Three teams. One of the highest-impact surfaces in fintech.
We're making international transfers feel as easy as sending a message. As an iOS product engineer, you won't just build that — you’ll decide what it looks like.
Our mission is to make sending money as easy as possible. As an iOS engineer, you’ll be working on making the app experience truly exceptional. International at heart, feeling local and frictionless.
How we work:
We’re a team split between London and Tallinn. We follow a hybrid working model, ensuring enough collaboration in-person and focus time where people find it best.
What will you be working on?:
Over 10 million customers will use what you build. That's not a vanity metric, it’s the weekly reality.
The role is UI- and product-focused. The work is deeply creative: flows that need to feel effortless whether it's a first transfer from São Paulo, or a hundredth from London. Where animation timing, information hierarchy, and interaction design are real engineering problems — not afterthoughts.
And this is not a ticket factory. You'll sit with product and design from day one of an idea, challenge what "best" looks like, and ship your answer. The strongest features we've built started with an engineer saying "what if we did it this way instead." We need more of that.
Concretely:
Craft send experiences that feel local everywhere
Build the future of recipient discovery: search, QR scanning, and more
Push what our iOS app can do, with thoughtful transitions, responsive interfaces, and micro-interactions that make people smile
Own features end-to-end, from technical design to watching real customers use your work
Raise the bar across Wise by collaborating with 60+ mobile engineers to lift UX and code quality across the entire app
What do you need?:
We know it's rare to tick every box. If you have most of these and are hungry to learn the rest, you should apply.
You've built app experiences people love and can show it
Strong in Swift
A genuine eye for craft: you notice when a transition is 100ms too slow or a layout doesn't breathe
You think in customer problems, not tickets: you push back when something doesn't make sense and propose what should exist instead
Familiar with architectural patterns like MVVM or VIPER (we use both, happy to explore others)
You write testable code and care about what happens after you merge Solid understanding of REST APIs, you're comfortable at the boundary between mobile and backend
You communicate clearly: technical ideas to non-technical people, strong opinions held loosely
You work autonomously, but you make the people around you better too
Nice to Have:
Experience with SwiftUI, Structured Concurrency, or CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions)
Familiarity with internationalisation patterns for apps serving many markets
A fintech background — but absolutely not required

Chief Risk Officer (UK P&C)
137058
Working hours: This role is available on a part-time, job-share or full-time basis.
Location: Flexible UK
We are looking for an experienced and forward-thinking leader to join UK Risk as Chief Risk Officer, UK P&C and Head of UK Risk Change.
This is a unique opportunity to combine senior risk leadership with responsibility for working alongside the UK CRO to shape the future capability of the UK Risk function. As Chief Risk Officer for UK P&C, you will provide independent second line oversight, challenge and insight across the UK P&C business, ensuring risk-taking remains aligned with Zurich's risk appetite, policy framework and regulatory expectations.
You will act as a trusted adviser to senior business leaders, providing risk perspectives on strategic decisions, business performance, growth opportunities, major projects and emerging risks. Through strong business partnering, insightful challenge and influential communication, you will help drive better even decision-making and strengthen risk outcomes across the business.
In addition, you will lead the UK Risk Change agenda, driving the evolution of the Risk function to become increasingly insight-led, data-driven, efficient and technology-enabled. This includes leading transformation initiatives across reporting, data, AI, and assurance.
Reporting directly to the UK Chief Risk Officer, you will be a member of the UK Risk Leadership Team and play a key role in shaping the future direction of risk management across Zurich UK.
Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of different ways, including part-time, flexible hours, job share, an element of working from home or compressed hours. This is because we want the best people for our roles, and we recognise that sometimes those people aren’t available full-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you may need.
What will you be doing?
UK P&C Chief Risk Officer
Provide independent oversight, challenge and insight across the UK P&C business, ensuring alignment with risk appetite, regulatory requirements and the Risk Management Framework.
Lead strategic risk engagement with P&C leadership teams, supporting decision-making on business performance, growth opportunities, material projects, outsourcing arrangements and emerging risks.
Deliver forward-looking risk insights and thematic analysis to support Executive, Board and Risk Committee discussions.
Lead the development of CRO reporting and management information, enhancing risk reporting through data, analytics and actionable insights.
Oversee deep dives into key risk themes and priority business areas, providing independent challenge, assurance and recommendations to improve risk management outcomes.
Oversee risk assessments and risk opinions for strategic initiatives, major business changes and material transactions.
Support the identification, assessment, monitoring and management of risks across the UK P&C business.
Promote a strong risk culture through effective stakeholder engagement, clear communication and pragmatic risk advice.
Ensure effective operation of governance forums and support delivery of high-quality reporting to Executive committees.
Maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, Group Risk Management and relevant regulatory bodies.
Head of Risk Change
Lead delivery of the UK Risk Change programme and associated operating model improvements.
Establish and oversee a Reporting, Data and AI Hub to enhance risk reporting, management information and data-driven assurance.
Accelerate the practical use of AI, automation and digital tools across reporting, assurance and knowledge management activities.
Enhance business partnering, assurance methodologies and risk insight capabilities across both Life and P&C businesses.
Drive simplification, proportionality and transparency in how the Risk function delivers its mandate.
Shape the future capability of UK Risk through improvements in technology, data, governance, operating model and ways of working.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation and learning across the Risk function.
Qualifications and experience
We're looking for an individual who combines deep risk expertise with strong strategic leadership and transformation experience.
Essential experience
Significant senior leadership experience within financial services, insurance or a regulated environment.
Strong understanding of insurance risk management frameworks, governance and regulatory expectations.
Proven experience of providing independent oversight, challenge and advice to senior management and Boards.
Demonstrable success in leading transformation, change or operating model improvement initiatives.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving outcomes across complex organisations.
Strong understanding of risk management disciplines, including operational, conduct, strategic and financial risks.
Experience developing risk reporting, management information and insight-led decision support.
Track record of building high-performing teams and leading through organisational change.
Desirable
Experience working directly with UK regulators and supervisory bodies.
Knowledge of emerging technologies, AI, data analytics and their application within risk management.
Professional qualification in risk management, actuarial science, finance, accounting or a related discipline.
What you'll bring
Strategic thinking with the ability to translate vision into practical delivery.
Strong commercial awareness and business judgement.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Credibility and confidence operating with Executive and Board-level audiences.
Curiosity, innovation and a passion for continuous improvement.
Ability to balance constructive challenge with collaborative business partnering.
Resilience, adaptability and a growth mindset.
A commitment to developing people and building inclusive, high-performing teams.
We’re committed to treating all applicants fairly and with respect, irrespective of their actual or assumed background, sexual orientation, disability or any other protected characteristic.
As an inclusive employer we also want to ensure that all candidates feel comfortable and are able to perform at their best during the interview. You’ll have the opportunity to let us know of any reasonable adjustment or practical support needed when you apply.
We’d love it if you could submit your application online. If you require an alternative method of applying, please send an email to recruitment@uk.zurich.com
Who we are
At Zurich we aspire to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. Together, we’re creating a brighter future for our customers, our people and our planet.

AIG::/job/London/Senior-Credit-Officer--.title: Senior Credit Officer, Political Risk Group
AIG::/job/London/Senior-Credit-Officer--.text:
At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us a Political Risk Credit Officer to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.
Make your mark in Trade Credit Lines & the Political Risk Group
AIG’s Credit Lines businesses (Trade Credit, Trade Finance, and Political Risk) help Corporates (medium and large companies), from a wide variety of industry sectors and Financial Institutions, navigate the complexities of local and global business practices by offering non-payment credit insurance solutions. The Political Risk Group within Credit Lines is responsible for underwriting short, medium- and long-term non-payment credit insurance transactions referencing sovereigns, state-owned companies, private corporations, banks, non-bank finance companies, and project finance transactions.
How you will create an impact
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Credit Officer to join our Credit Risk Team in London. This position is suited for professionals with a solid grounding in corporate credit analysis and financial assessment You will contribute to evaluating borrower risks, supporting underwriting decisions, and helping maintain a high-quality credit portfolio.
Responsibilities:
Credit Analysis
Perform annual regular credit reviews and credit rating recommendations for Structured Corporate Credit and Project Finance obligors within the PRG UK portfolio
Provide credit analysis across transactions of various credit products and contribute towards deal memos regarding Credit Risk.
Establish limits on appetite as per obligor group to support specific transactions and provide general capacity
Execute approvals based on own authority to be delegated or present review results to internal authority holders.
Respond to Underwriter ad-hoc requests for credit appetite
Perform obligor visits/calls as needed and participate on market presentations for Investors/Analysts.
Participate on internal presentations of transactions covering Credit R isk of obligor.
Portfolio Management
Ensure internal credit ratings are appropriate coverage for Obligors names in the assigned portfolio s .
Ensure internal credit rating aging is within Credit Lines and AIG Credit Policy Guidelines.
Ensure max exposure limits are in place and in date for all obligor groups assigned to the managed portfolio s .
Ensure all approvals and related supporting materials are documented and saved within the appropriate credit management systems.
Respond to ad-hoc exposure inquiries from Credit Lines or Enterprise Risk M anagement.
Team Collaboration
Collaboration with the Heads of the Credit Lines business to support achievement of Credit Lines business objectives.
Collaboration with Political Risk Group Underwriters regarding PRG UK Portfolio obligors to obtain information required for the assessment
Collaboration with Political Risk Group Underwriters regarding Credit Transactions
Collaboration with the Trade Credit Credit Officers regarding overlaps in exposure.
What you’ll need to succeed
Minimum 10 years’ credit risk and transaction analysis experience developed within a leading bank, trade credit or equivalent organisation.
Experience of using different market leading credit risk analysis techniques and tools
Understanding of Credit Lines products and their respective credit risk drivers and mitigants
Strong communication skills, written and oral, presentations
Organisational skills and project management
Ability to manage time pressure, deadlines and competing tasks/ prioritise on behalf of the credit officer team
Ability to handle a varied workload in a diverse and growing portfolio.
Interpersonal skills - team player with internal and external stakeholders/ clients
Multiple Languages helpful, ability to engage with diverse, global teams
Willingness to travel regionally is desirable
Business acumen
Ability to work in a changing environment
#LI-AIG
At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.
Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters
At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.
Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world
American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.
Welcome to a culture of inclusion
We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.
AIG provides equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected categories.
AIG is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants and employees with disabilities. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation, please send an email to candidatecare@aig.com .

UW - Underwriting

Airwallex::9261f89e-0703-45c0-a80e-d5f6a.text:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX
Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 676,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.
We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.
ABOUT THE TEAM
The Financial Crimes Compliance team builds and oversees Airwallex’s global financial crime framework across AML/CTF, sanctions, risk assessment, FCC operations, monitoring and testing, and investigations. The team works closely with Product, Operations, Risk, Regulatory Legal & Compliance, and regional MLROs to make sure our controls are well designed, practical, and effective as Airwallex scales globally.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
As Senior Manager, FCC Program Management, you’ll lead a multi-year effort to strengthen Airwallex’s global financial crime framework as we scale across products and regions. This is a new role with broad scope: you’ll shape the target operating model, improve processes and systems, and bring stronger discipline to FCC-wide change. You’ll be the central connector across senior leaders and cross-functional teams, making sure work is practical, well sequenced, and built to stick in BAU.
This role is hybrid. Based in London.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead a global, multi-year FCC transformation across operating model, process, systems, testing, and controls.
Build and drive the roadmap, with clear sequencing across priorities, dependencies, and risks.
Use AI, automation, and data tools to improve FCC program tracking, reporting, and delivery across complex global workstreams.
Run disciplined governance across working groups, SteerCos, RAID, and executive updates.
Work hands-on with FCC and cross-functional leaders to turn complexity into clear plans, decisions, and action.
Define success measures, evidence progress, and lead smooth transition into BAU.
WHO YOU ARE
We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:
10 years leading large, multi-workstream transformation programs in financial services or fintech.
Direct experience in financial crime program change across areas such as AML/CTF, sanctions, FCC operations, and monitoring and testing.
Practical experience using AI, automation, and modern tools to improve program planning, reporting, and execution in complex environments.
A track record of delivering multiple global or multi-region programs at more than one complex institution.
Highly organized, hands-on, and strong at turning complexity into action.
Strong executive presence, clear communication skills, and project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
Experience in fintech, payments, or digital banking, ideally in fast-moving, global environments.
Background in consulting, regulatory remediation, or large-scale risk and compliance change.
Strong proficiency with program tools, dashboards, and executive reporting.
APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS
To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.
Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

BBVA Italy::/job/BBVA-One-Canada-Square-.title: CIB BANKS & FINANCE CREDIT RISK ASSOCIATE
BBVA Italy::/job/BBVA-One-Canada-Square-.location:
BBVA, One Canada Square (44th Floor), Canary Wharf
 London, E14 5AA (UK)
BBVA Italy::/job/BBVA-One-Canada-Square-.text:
Excited to grow your career?
BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. We are more than 121,000 professionals working in multidisciplinary teams with profiles as diverse as financiers, legal experts, data scientists, developers, engineers and designers.
CIB Risk Banks & Finance is responsible for assessing the credit risk of financial institutions, assigning internal ratings and defining the maximum risk appetite, both for credit and settlement risk
About the job:
The candidate will join a team of 1 0 professionals covering banks and other financial institutions. The role requires a strong understanding of financial institutions, their financial statements and risk profiles, as well as the products that generate credit and settlement exposure. Staying up to date on markets, regulation and product developments is key to supporting sound risk decisions and contributing to healthy and profitable business growth.
As a Financial Institutions Credit Risk Analyst, the main responsibilities of the position include:
Credit analysis and risk assessment of financial institutions , with a primary focus on banks. This includes analyzing financial statements and key credit fundamentals, including profitability, asset quality, capital, funding and liquidity, as well as assessing the relevant industry, country, regulatory and market environment.
Preparation of risk proposals and definition of limits / maximum risk appetite by product , summarized in the Financial Program, and presentation of proposals to the relevant Risk Committees. As part of this process, you will assess the individual credit profile of each institution, calculate its internal rating and determine an appropriate risk appetite across different products and types of exposure.
Understanding and assessment of the products and transactions generating exposure to financial institutions , considering their specific credit and settlement risk characteristics when defining limits and risk appetite.
Close and regular interaction with Business , discussing risk needs, proposed transactions and limits prior to their submission to committee. The role also involves coordination with other GRM teams across geographies and with local credit risk teams, which in turn interact with their respective local business areas.
Participation in cross-functional and multidisciplinary projects , including the development and implementation of new internal rating models and initiatives aimed at introducing AI capabilities into GRM processes.
What are we looking for?
We are particularly interested in candidates who are already performing similar credit risk or counterparty risk functions involving banks or other financial institutions , and who combine strong financial analysis capabilities with a good understanding of financial products.
At least 3 years of relevant experience in Credit Risk, Counterparty Risk or a closely related function within a leading financial institution , with direct experience analyzing banks and/or other financial institutions such as insurance companies, funds or other regulated financial entities.
Strong accounting and financial analysis skills are essential. Candidates should be comfortable analyzing the financial statements of banks or other financial institutions and assessing their profitability, asset quality, capital, funding, liquidity and overall creditworthiness.
Good knowledge of financial products and their associated credit and settlement risks is highly valued. In particular, candidates should be able to understand how different products and transactions translate into exposures, limits and risk appetite for financial institution counterparties.
Strong analytical judgment and the ability to translate detailed financial, sector and product analysis into clear credit conclusions and risk recommendations for senior decision-making and Risk Committees .
Strong communication skills and the ability to interact effectively with Business and Risk stakeholders across different products and geographies.
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related field. An international academic background and/or studies undertaken in English will be positively valued.
Advanced level of English (minimum C1). Additional languages (B2 or above) will be positively valued.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint . Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Capital IQ Pro & experience using AI tools and an interest in applying them to credit risk processes will also be valued.
Please note that priority will be given to candidates who are eligible to work in the UK.
Skills:
Client Orientation, Empathy, Ethics, Innovation, Proactive Thinking
