Howden::/job/London---One-Creechurch-Pla.title: Howden Private Capital Strategy & Operations Graduate Programme 2027
Howden::/job/London---One-Creechurch-Pla.text:
Who are we?
Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.
People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.
Howden Private Capital Strategy & Operations Graduate Programme
Please read before submitting: You may only apply to one graduate programme for our 2027 intake. Submitting duplicate applications will result in them not being considered.
Location: London
Start date: September 2027
Salary: £40,000
Working structure: Hybrid
Strategy & Operations Graduate Programme
Help Build a New Global Business from the Ground Up
Looking for a graduate role where you'll gain exposure to business strategy, operations, commercial decision-making and senior leadership from day one?
Join Howden Private Capital (HPC), a newly established global division serving private equity, private credit, infrastructure and institutional investor clients. As a Graduate Analyst in Strategy & Operations, you'll work directly with the Chief Operating Officer to help shape, build and grow a new business within one of the world's leading insurance groups.
Unlike many graduate roles, this position offers broad exposure across every part of the division. You'll support strategic projects, business planning, market research, financial reporting, client initiatives and operational improvements, whilst working closely with senior stakeholders across Howden.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is curious, commercially minded and eager to learn how businesses are built and scaled.
This is a permanent role supported by a structured 18-month development programme, designed to accelerate your professional confidence, commercial understanding and long-term career growth.
What you’ll be doing?
You'll begin with a structured induction before joining the Strategy & Operations team, where you'll work directly with senior leaders across the business.
During the programme, you’ll:
Research private capital funds, investors, competitors and market trends to support business growth and strategy.
Prepare briefing notes, market analysis and presentations for senior internal and client meetings.
Support the development and execution of business plans and strategic initiatives.
Prepare client-facing materials, including capability presentations, meeting packs and business updates.
Work alongside marketing teams on campaigns, events and thought leadership projects.
Coordinate projects, monitor milestones and support the delivery of key business objectives.
Collaborate with colleagues across Howden, including Financial Institutions, Capital Advisory & Placement (CAP) and international teams.
Who are we looking for?
No insurance experience is needed; we’ll teach you everything you need to know!
You'll be:
A recent graduate, or in your final year of university study.
Curious about how businesses grow and make strategic decisions.
Interested in strategy, operations, consulting, private capital or financial services.
Analytical and comfortable working with information, data and commercial problems.
Able to articulate your points clearly and confidently.
Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where plans and priorities can evolve.
Someone who takes ownership, shows initiative and enjoys learning.
A collaborative team player who enjoys building relationships across different teams.
To be eligible for our programme, you must have the full and unrestricted right to work in the UK.
Application process
Our application process is designed to help you show your potential, not to test what you already know!
Online application form – no CV required: We believe you're more than just a document, so we won’t ask you to submit a CV. Please upload a blank document on the application form.
Online gamified assessment: We’ve created games that will help us understand your natural strengths and how you approach different situations. There are no right or wrong answers. You can complete this stage on your phone or laptop, whichever suits you best!
Pre-recorded video interview: You will record your answers to a few questions using your phone or laptop, giving you the chance to tell us more about yourself in your own time in a relaxed setting.
Assessment centre: Our final stage is an in-person assessment centre at one of our offices. You'll take part in some fun group activities and meet our team in a relaxed setting. This day is all about getting to know you better and for you to see what it's like to be part of Howden and experience our culture. We'll cover all your travel costs for this day, because where you are now, shouldn’t hold back your future!
Why should you apply?
At Howden, people are at the heart of everything we do. As an employee-owned business, we believe success is built through collaboration, learning and supporting one another. You'll join a permanent role from day one and take part in our structured 18-month development programme, designed to accelerate your technical, commercial and professional growth.
You'll also benefit from:
A starting salary of £40,000 and a generous pension scheme.
Opportunity to complete fully funded professional qualifications, such as the CII or CFA, to support your long-term career development.
Structured learning and development through our 18-month graduate development programme.
25 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays and an additional day off at Christmas.
Access to discounted personal health policies, wellbeing support and a range of employee benefits and insurance products.
2 days allocated to take part in volunteering schemes.
Ready to apply?
Follow our TikTok pages: @earlycareersjo and @millieinsurancecareers, and explore our Connectr hub to discover more about Howden, our culture, and the insurance industry. You'll find resources to help you prepare for our recruitment process and understand which career path could be the best fit for you.
Please read before submitting: You may only apply to one graduate programme for our 2027 intake. Submitting duplicate applications will result in additional applications not being considered.
What do we offer in return?
A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond
Reasonable adjustments
We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.
If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.
*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.
Permanent

Location: London
Start date: September 2027
Salary: £40,000
Working structure: Hybrid
Due Diligence Graduate Programme
Gain Exposure to Live Private Equity and M&A Transactions
Looking for a graduate role where you'll develop analytical, commercial and problem-solving skills while working on live transactions?
Join Howden Private Capital's Due Diligence team, a newly established global division serving private equity, private credit, infrastructure and institutional investor clients. As a Graduate Analyst, you’ll learn how we support private equity firms, investors and their advisers as they assess and manage risks during acquisitions, investments and corporate transactions.
Our clients are some of the world's leading private equity firms, investors and legal advisers. We help them understand potential insurance and risk exposures before they invest, providing insights that support informed business decisions.
This is a fast-paced, deal-driven environment where no two days are the same. You'll gain exposure to mergers and acquisitions, private equity, risk analysis and client advisory work while building a strong foundation for a long-term career in financial services.
This is a permanent role supported by a structured 18-month development programme, designed to accelerate your professional confidence, technical expertise and career growth.
What you’ll be doing?
You'll begin with a structured induction before joining the Due Diligence team, where you'll work alongside experienced specialists on live client projects.
During the programme, you’ll:
Support insurance due diligence projects for private equity firms, investors and corporate clients.
Research companies, industries and market trends to support transaction activity.
Analyse information and identify potential risks associated with acquisitions and investments.
Assist in preparing client reports, presentations and transaction-related deliverables.
Support colleagues working on live mergers, acquisitions and investment transactions.
Work closely with clients, legal advisers and internal stakeholders across Howden.
Develop an understanding of how insurance and risk management support investment decisions and value creation.
Who are we looking for?
No insurance experience is needed; we’ll teach you everything you need to know!
You'll be:
A recent graduate, or in your final year of university study.
Curious, analytical and motivated to learn.
Interested in business, financial services, private equity, transactions or consulting.
Able to articulate your points clearly and confidently.
Someone who enjoys working with others and building relationships.
Comfortable analysing information and solving problems.
Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
Someone who takes ownership, shows initiative and enjoys asking questions.
A collaborative team player who enjoys working across different teams and functions.

Roles at Stripe

Role details
Enterprise Field Marketing Manager
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
The Stripe EMEA Marketing team is a dynamic and rapidly growing group dedicated to transforming customers into enthusiastic advocates for Stripe. Collaborating closely with sales, we focus on accelerating the path to purchase and enhancing product adoption among our user base. Our regional marketing efforts involve crafting and executing tailored marketing plans that resonate with local audiences, as well as spearheading our most significant conferences and sponsorships that drive go-to-market (GTM) success and business growth. Join us and be part of a culture that celebrates teamwork, innovates boldly, and makes a meaningful impact.
What you’ll do
You’ll be part of the EMEA Marketing team and be able to craft our enterprise and industry marketing strategy for the UK market while developing a strong trusted relationship working hand-in-hand with sales teams to drive successful user outcomes. The UK Enterprise Marketing Manager will define and execute field marketing program activations for integrated campaigns, targeted regional campaigns aligned to sales priorities, mid-funnel programs to accelerate leads and pipeline, high-tough programs, and Account Based Marketing. The ideal candidate is data-driven, and has an unbridled passion for working hand-in-hand with sales teams to drive successful user outcomes. As a key member of the EMEA Marketing team, this is a great opportunity to build and have an impact on the business.
Responsibilities
Craft enterprise marketing strategy and execute field marketing programs across enterprise customer segments (established enterprises, digital native businesses, software platforms), with emphasis on industry focused programs while solidly collaborating across key GTM stakeholders.
Own key business and revenue metrics across the sales funnel (pipeline) and customer growth and retention.
Lead local Customer Marketing programs, ranging from case study creation to customer speaking engagements.
Partner with EMEA demand generation and product marketing to refine our targeting and segmentation, and to identify, scope, and produce or localize compelling content, marketing assets and programs to drive demand.
Define and execute full funnel UK marketing plans including digital marketing, demand generation campaigns, sales prospecting programs and ABM, executive engagement, virtual and in-person field events, and third party tradeshows and conferences as well as amplifying Stripe brand with users’ voices though case study production.
Track, measure, and communicate program results, continually optimize for efficiency and scale, and seek to generate new global best practices through experimental efforts.
Be creative in finding new ways of advising a diverse range of enterprise personas about the value Stripe brings to businesses.
Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements
7+ years of relevant B2B marketing experience in the UK Enterprise Technology market across multiple customer segments including specific experience with localizing global content, event management, field marketing, Account-based marketing and multi-touch campaigns to generate demand.
Proven track record of defining and executing B2B marketing strategies that deliver against funnel metrics and KPIs.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including being able to convey complex topics with simplicity.
Experience delivering tailored marketing content and experiences for customer segments spanning from early stage startups to the largest enterprise companies.
Superb organization and project management skills and the capacity to manage multiple complex projects at once.
Experience scaling through/and or leveraging agency and contractor resources.
Understanding and/or experience with CRM/Salesforce, account-based marketing, events marketing and email marketing tactics and technology
Preferred qualifications
A startup mentality with a bias to action and the ability to flex in a fast-paced industry and work environment.
Experience marketing B2B cloud services and/or software solutions.
Excellent analytical skills and the ability to craft actionable insights from complex data.
Resourceful, creative and dedicated to achieving operational and creative excellence.
Understanding of the payments, financial technology, and/or ecommerce industries and partner ecosystems.
Demonstrated success delivering marketing programs with and through consulting and technology partners.
In-office expectations
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
Pay and benefits
The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is £81,400 - £122,000. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.
Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.
We look forward to hearing from you.
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
Apply now

London, England, United Kingdom · Field Sales
Loading Apply now
Director of Sales, North & Central Europe
Location: London, United Kingdom (office based)
Team description
North & Central Europe is one of SumUp's biggest and most competitive sales regions, spanning the UK, Ireland, the Netherlands, Germany, Austria and Switzerland. As the region has grown, we've moved from a country led model to a structure where sales leaders each specialise in one channel across the region, giving them the focus to go deeper while staying joined up across markets.
This role sits above that structure as the single owner of commercial performance across the region: deciding where budget and capacity should go, setting the pace on forecasting and pipeline discipline, and developing the leadership team behind ambitious growth targets.
It's a rare opportunity to shape a brand new regional structure from the ground up, working across some of SumUp's most complex and most competitive markets, while staying close enough to the field to inspire teams and help them solve their toughest problems.
What you'll do
Own commercial performance across all sales channels in the region, working closely with sales leaders to spot opportunities for markets and channels to perform even better, and turning those insights into practical plans that lift results
Build a clear go to market plan for the region that accounts for local competition and market maturity
Decide where to invest budget and hiring capacity across markets and channels, and reallocate resource towards the areas delivering the strongest returns
Support and develop senior sales leaders to strengthen pipeline leadership, accelerate performance, and ensure long-term succession
Spend regular time in the field and in local sales offices, working directly alongside reps and managers to stay close to what's actually happening on the ground
You'll be great for this role if
You have proven ownership of regional or business level commercial outcomes, with a track record of turning around underperformance rather than only scaling something that already worked
You have strong commercial understanding of SMB sales, ideally gained through high exposure to sales environments such as payments, fintech or another SMB technology sector
You have extensive experience leading senior sales leaders, including setting targets, forecasting, and allocating budget and capacity across several markets
You're comfortable operating across both strategy and execution, including regular travel and time spent on the sales floor rather than working from behind a desk
You have an ability to build trust quickly with senior stakeholders, inspire teams towards more ambitious targets, and hold people accountable for delivering on them
Why you should join SumUp
🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central Covent Garden location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup
🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves
🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental
🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta
💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%)
🛡️ Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary
🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
About SumUp
Be empowered to do more that matters.
At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 38 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.
Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team Opens in new window of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.
SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website , and follow our journey on LinkedIn Opens in new window , Instagram Opens in new window , and TikTok Opens in new window .

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

Visa::/job/GB---London-United-Kingdom/Di.text:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Job Description
Visa Commercial Solutions is one of Visa's fastest growing businesses, helping financial institutions, fintech's and corporates transform the way they pay and get paid.
This role is responsible for leading the Large & Middle Market (LMM) business across Europe, driving sales performance, revenue growth and market expansion across one of Visa's most important commercial segments. The successful candidate will work closely with market teams, financial institutions, strategic partners and internal stakeholders to accelerate adoption of Visa Commercial Solutions capabilities and unlock new growth opportunities across the European B2B payments ecosystem.
This is a senior business development and sales leadership role, requiring an individual who can combine strategic thinking with strong commercial execution, build executive relationships, influence decision making across a complex organization and deliver measurable business results across multiple markets.
What we expect of you, day to day
Lead the growth of the Large & Middle Market business across Europe, driving revenue, payment volume and client expansion through effective business development, sales execution and market engagement.
Partner closely with market sales teams, account executives and clients to identify, develop and execute opportunities that accelerate growth, deepen client relationships and increase adoption of Visa Commercial Solutions capabilities.
Develop a strong understanding of the commercial payments landscape across Europe and use market insight, customer trends and competitive intelligence to shape growth strategies, prioritise opportunities and support market execution.
Work with Product, Partnerships, Solution Sales and other cross-functional teams to bring new solutions to market, unlock new payment flows and ensure Visa continues to meet the evolving needs of financial institutions and their clients.
Build and maintain senior relationships with key clients, partners and industry stakeholders, positioning Visa as a trusted commercial partner and supporting executive-level engagement across the region.
Drive sales excellence through disciplined pipeline management, forecasting, performance governance and the development of scalable go-to-market approaches that can be leveraged consistently across European markets.
Support and enable client-facing teams through thought leadership, coaching and the sharing of best practices, helping to build a high-performance sales culture focused on client success, collaboration and commercial outcomes.
Represent Visa externally through client engagements, industry events and strategic forums, strengthening Visa's position as a leader in commercial payments and business-to-business commerce.
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
Qualifications
Significant business development, sales leadership or commercial management experience within payments, financial services, fintech or a related technology sector.
Demonstrated success delivering revenue growth, exceeding sales targets and managing complex commercial opportunities across multiple markets and stakeholder groups.
Strong understanding of commercial payments, business-to-business payment flows and the broader ecosystem of financial institutions, technology providers, fintech's and strategic partners.
Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies that drive commercial outcomes, increase market penetration and support long-term business growth.
Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior executives, influence key decision makers and engage effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.
Strong commercial acumen, analytical capability and experience developing business cases, evaluating opportunities and navigating complex sales cycles and negotiations.
Experience working across matrixed organizations and leading initiatives involving multiple functions, markets and strategic priorities.
Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, with the ability to represent Visa confidently in executive, client and industry settings.
Proven leadership capabilities with experience developing talent, fostering collaboration and building high-performing teams.
A highly commercial, customer-focused mindset with a passion for driving growth and helping clients solve complex business challenges.
Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Wise::744000152433354.title: Head of Business Operations - Wise Platform
Wise::744000152433354.text:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
Wise has already pioneered new ways for people to transfer money across borders and currencies. Through Wise Platform, we enable banks and enterprise businesses to leverage our multi-currency infrastructure to serve their own customers. We are one of the fastest-growing fintechs, moving over £9 billion monthly with a global operations team of over 2,500 people.
Your Mission
As the Head of Business Operations, your mission is to enhance and scale our servicing and operations for our platform partners. You will lead the global operational roadmap, ensuring our servicing model meets the expectations of our partners and scales in line with our growth.
What you will do:
In this senior leadership role, you will balance high-level strategy with hands-on execution across multiple functional domains. Your focus will be threefold:
Own Servicing and Operational KPIs: You own servicing and operational success, working with cross-functional teams to fix structural problems when needed or incubate operations from scratch for new partnership types or products
Lead Partner Success: You own our partners’ operational success, ensuring that their KPIs and SLAs are stable and always green
Influence Without Authority: You influence product teams and indirectly lead the operational teams, ensuring that they are set up correctly to be high-performing, have enough capacity, consistently meet KPIs and are prioritising the right things for partners
This role will give you the opportunity to:
Choose your path to impact: we believe people are most empowered when they can act autonomously. So rather than telling you what to do, you’ll work with your team to create a vision of your own. Of course, you can always gather feedback from smart, curious people across Wise but you’ll have the freedom to make your own calls
Grow as a leader: Grow and inspire cross-functional teams from customer success and servicing and operations to join our mission
Get amazing exposure: to the full breadth and depth of our product and servicing operations from customer support, FinCrime, global expansion and new product launches
Be part of our mission: to make money without borders the new normal
You have 8+ years of experience in a broad role at an innovative company within the payments ecosystem, driving large projects to completion
Leadership in Operations. You have a successful track record in similar senior operational leadership roles within the FinTech, Financial Services or Technology industries, working with people and processes as well as products. Demonstrated ability to execute at very high level in a variety of customer service-type contexts
You’re entrepreneurial and hands-on. You have delivered high impact solutions end to end in data-driven environments
You are fluent with data, can use spreadsheets and analytics dashboards for insights, preferably you know SQL and Python
You can go through loads of qualitative data point: customer contacts, operational cases and side-by-sides sessions
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs .
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram .

You’ll own the verticals performance and be willing to get your hands dirty, helping analysts and cross-functional partners to work through some of the most complex and ambiguous problem areas.
You’ll manage a team from day one, while building and scaling a high-performing product analytics function for the vertical. You’ll set a clear analytics vision and roadmap, develop analysts and establish the data, metrics and ways of working needed to support the vertical as it grows.
You’ll help us answer questions such as:
Where are our biggest product, growth and commercial opportunities?
Who should we be building and selling our products and solutions for?
What products should we build or improve to unlock growth?
How can we reduce time to revenue and ensure partners scale effectively?
Where is friction occurring across the onboarding and transaction lifecycle, and how should we address it?
How should we position and prioritise our products to create the greatest long-term impact?
How should we structure and resource our teams?
WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
Own the vertical’s growth and performance end-to-end. You’ll define and proactively manage the vertical and sub-teams’ KPIs and metrics suite, ensuring there is a clear understanding of product performance. You’ll identify root causes, undertake deep dives and work with counterparts to turn your insights into actionable recommendations.
Lead product discovery, market and opportunity sizing for product initiatives, understanding their short- and long-term impact against our KPIs. You’ll use this work to shape strategy, prioritise opportunities and influence product and commercial roadmaps.
Build and scale a high-performing product analytics function as the vertical grows, setting its vision, priorities, operating model and ways of working. You’ll also build the analytics foundations needed to scale, including reliable data models, clear metric definitions and effective self-serve reporting.
Lead, coach and develop a team of product analysts from day one, creating a high bar for analytical quality, commercial thinking and impact.
Partner with product, engineering, operations and commercial leadership to turn complex analysis into compelling narratives and clear recommendations, influencing senior stakeholders and driving cross-functional teams to action.
WHAT YOU’LL BRING
You’re an experienced product analytics leader with a strong track record of building, managing and scaling high-performing analytics teams.
You have experience working in high-growth B2B tech companies and have partnered closely with product, and preferably enterprise sales teams before.
You have experience in fintech, preferably payments, or are excited to build an expert understanding of our products, partners and competitors.
You’re commercially minded - able to translate analysis into impact and comfortable with opportunity sizing, forecasting, prioritisation and scenario modelling.
You’re proficient in SQL and know your way around data pipeline management tools such as Snowflake, dbt, Git, Airflow, Python and Lightdash. You’re comfortable owning analytics from data transformation through to actionable insights.
You’re an expert at crafting dashboards and visualisations that bring data to life, tell a clear story and offer diagnostic power.
You’re solution-oriented and able to own projects from start to finish. You’re comfortable motivating stakeholders across Wise, negotiating priorities and timelines, and making things happen.
You’re an excellent communicator, able to form your own opinions and articulate them effectively to influence senior stakeholders.
You’re comfortable operating at both strategic and hands-on levels - setting the direction for the function while getting into the details when needed.
PROCESS
1) Screening call with recruiter - 30 mins
2) Take home Case Study - 7 days to submit
3) Technical Interview - 1.5 hours
4) Stakeholder Interview - 1 hour
5) Final Interview - 1 hour

This role is responsible for supporting revenue impacting pricing and billing activities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance of client billing and related system setups. Leverage AI in optimising and improving processes

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear and concise outputs

Visa::/job/GB---London-United-Kingdom/Pr.title: Product Manager
Visa::/job/GB---London-United-Kingdom/Pr.text:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Job Description
Visa, a global leader in payments and technology, is at the heart of 259 billion transactions annually, connecting consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and governmental entities across 200+ countries. Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable, and secure payment network, empowering individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive. Our unified purpose is to uplift everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. Join our purpose-driven company and make an impact. Experience Life at Visa.
The Role
This Product Manager role sits within Visa Direct’s Currencycloud product, focused on building the infrastructure that powers how money moves globally. You’ll help businesses send, receive and manage funds across borders quickly, cheaply, and with full transparency and control. Money movement sits at the heart of how businesses and consumers operate, so the work you do here has real, measurable impact.
You’ll own a product area end to end, working with a dedicated engineering team and cross-functional partners to decide what matters most and how to move it forward. You’ll shape the vision and roadmap for your area based on client needs, business goals, market context and what you learn through discovery.
You’ll spend time understanding how clients use our products, where the experience breaks down, and where we can create something better. From there, you’ll define and launch features, stay close to how they perform in the real world, and use data, feedback and judgement to decide what to do next.
We’re looking for people with high agency, who take initiative, create clarity and don’t wait for perfect direction. You’ll have space to own problems end to end, influence beyond your immediate team, and deliver meaningful outcomes with your team. This role reports into a Product Director or Group Product Manager.
Responsibilities
Strategy and Vision:
Collaborate in crafting your tribe’s strategy by doing deep market, customer, competitor and technology research.
Develop a product strategy and roadmap for your team based on company strategy, tribe strategy, deep market, customer, competitor and technology research.
Build alignment and secure buy-in for the product strategy from colleagues and stakeholders.
Turn strategy into a clear, prioritised backlog and roadmap for your team.
Discovery:
Lead discovery with clients to uncover real problems, unmet needs and new opportunities
Work with customers and colleagues to generate, test and refine ideas for new features and products.
Go deep on payment flows, bank and operational processes, and systems maps to understand how things work end to end.
Work with internal & external teams to develop and maintain clear technical documentation
Ensure requirements are detailed enough to take into sprint, including functional & non-functional requirements
Use what you learn from customers and data to separate signal from noise, challenge assumptions, and focus the team on the highest-impact problems.
Delivery:
Manage end-to-end product development, from shaping the problem through to building and launching it for our clients.
Prioritize the product backlog based on customer, commercial, and strategic value, potentially across more than one scrum team
Partner closely with engineering and delivery counterparts to keep the team focused, effective and moving at pace.
Give clear context on what is being prioritised and why, so the team can make good decisions quickly
Adoption:
Collaborate with the Product Marketing and GTM teams to define the go-to-market plans, positioning and launches.
Drive product adoption across various regions, segments, and use cases, not just releasing features.
Measure product performance and impact after launch and use data and insight to decide what to improve, scale or stop.
What Success Looks Like
A clear strategy, roadmap and backlog that connect customer problems to business outcomes.
Features and improvements shipped at pace that solve real problems and create measurable value.
Strong product judgement, shown through good prioritisation, clear trade-offs and thoughtful use of data.
Owning a product area that is gaining adoption, performing well and improving over time
This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
Qualifications
Basic Qualifications
You don’t need to tick every box to apply, but this role will be a strong fit if you have most of the following:
At least 3-4 years proven experience in a Product Owner/Product Manager role, preferably in a software-first Fintech or tech start-up
Experience owning a product area or major initiative from discovery through launch and iteration.
Experience shipping products and can clearly demonstrate impact by moving key customer and business metrics.
Strong prioritisation skills, with the ability to define and manage a backlog and make tough trade-offs.
Comfortable working with agile frameworks like Scrum or Kanban, and across 1-2 teams
Experience crafting a vision for your product based on customer discovery, market research, data analysis, etc.
Preferably domain knowledge in Fintech - e.g. payments, FX, transaction banking or trading
Experience shipping features to customers, measuring impact, and using those learnings to shape future plans.
Preferred Qualifications
You have a strong bias to action and a track record of getting things done.
Y ou take ownership, follow through, and hold a high bar for the quality of your work
You’re strong with stakeholders and can influence across cross-functional teams without formal authority.
You’re analytical and commercially sharp, and able to turn insight into action.
You’re comfortable challenging the status quo and always curious about the way things work
You communicate clearly and confidently, in writing and in person.
You bring structure and attention to detail, while staying focused on the bigger picture.
You’re comfortable working in a scaling environment where not everything is defined.
Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Visa::/job/GB---London-United-Kingdom/Se.title: Senior Finance Manager - 12 month FTC
Visa::/job/GB---London-United-Kingdom/Se.text:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Job Description
This is a fixed term contract until November 2027
The Senior FP&A Manager will be a key member of the Visa Direct Network & Operations FP&A team, providing financial leadership, insight, and analytical support across revenue planning, forecasting, performance management, and client-level reporting.
The role will take ownership of the financial planning and reporting activities supporting both the Visa Direct Account (VDA), Visa Direct Wallet (VDW) and CurrencyCloud businesses, with a particular focus on CurrencyCloud revenue forecasting, transaction and foreign exchange volumes, client performance, month-end reporting, and data integrity. You will partner closely with regional FP&A, Sales, Account Management, Revenue Operations, and Data Insights teams to improve financial visibility, explain performance, identify risks and opportunities, and support informed decision-making.
This is a hands-on role that combines commercial finance partnering with detailed financial analysis, systems expertise, and reporting transformation.
Financial Planning and Forecasting
Lead the revenue components of the Annual Operating Plan and quarterly Outlook processes for the relevant VDNO business areas.
Develop robust revenue forecasts using client-level revenue, transaction volume, payment value, foreign exchange volume, sales pipeline, launch timing, and churn assumptions.
Partner with regional FP&A teams to provide accurate and timely client-level revenue and volume information.
Work with Sales and Account Management teams to understand expected client performance, new opportunities, implementation timelines, and emerging revenue risks.
Produce forecasts for key revenue streams, including transactional revenue, FX Marketplace revenue, interest income, and payment transaction volumes.
Maintain and enhance forecasting models, ensuring assumptions are transparent, appropriately documented, and supported by underlying data.
Prepare clear commentary and presentation materials explaining forecast movements, assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Coordinate the loading of revenue forecasts into Oracle EPM and support restatement of the plan using updated constant-dollar exchange rates.
Month-End Revenue Performance and Reconciliation
Own the month-end client revenue reconciliation following the financial close.
Develop a complete view of revenue by client and revenue stream to support variance analysis against budget and forecast.
Ensure revenue information is accurately loaded and available in the relevant reporting.
Maintain a strong control environment around client-level revenue reporting, reconciliation, and data lineage.
Management Reporting and Business Performance
Lead the preparation of FP&A revenue reporting and commentary for monthly flash and performance review processes.
Provide regional FP&A teams with clear explanations of revenue performance and material variances.
Produce and distribute client-level revenue reporting to support regional and central finance requirements.
Translate complex revenue and operational data into concise, decision-relevant insights for senior finance and business stakeholders.
Identify underlying performance drivers, distinguishing sustainable business trends from timing differences, manual adjustments, credits, reserves, and other one-off items.
AI: Data, Reporting, and Business Intelligence
Leverage AI to enhance, simplify, automate, and improve the scalability existing processes for the production and distribution of recurring financial and operational reporting across the VDNO business
Maintain and enhance the existing reporting suites, with focus on customer/base activity, revenue, commissions, payment, collection, FX, client cash balance, and trade roll reporting.
Partner with Data Insights and technology teams to test and implement improvements to revenue reporting.
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
Qualifications
Graduate, undergraduate degree and/or other Finance-related professionally recognized accreditations (e.g. CIMA, ACA, ACCA)
Professional finance experience, preferably in global publicly listed, government regulated payments company
Outstanding analytical and quantitative skills, can-do attitude to resolve tough business problems with well-structured analyses
Strong interest and experience in AI and agentic solutions
Highly strategic combined with a strong business acumen
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to be able to “connect the dots” and approach issue resolution with a “forward-looking” view to anticipate and address problems.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including excellent written, oral, listening and presentational skills and ability to work well under pressure and interact at all levels as a thought-partner.
Capable of handling and prioritizing multiple tasks, possess good judgment and organizational skills, able to work independently and be flexible.
Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

This is an exciting opportunity to develop the program in a global company. About the Role:
In the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Risk team we are developing systems which are a mixture of unsupervised and supervised learning, with GenAI to detect and mitigate Financial Crime on a global scale. You will be making sure the AML Risk Data Science team is well equipped and working on cutting-edge technology to sustainably support Wise’s growing customer, transaction and product space.
You will be stepping into an already functioning, but growing product team.
Here’s how you’ll be contributing
AML Risk Detection System Development
Developing efficient and effective AML detection controls using a mixture of unsupervised, semi supervised and supervised learning with GenAI
Creating frameworks to prove controls coverage at a regional level
Developing technologies to serve Wise’s diverse international user base
Building a team of high performing specialists
Working with product managers and engineering leads to understand staffing requirements
Hiring specialists
Mentoring more junior members of the team on technical and non-technical skillsets
Performance Testing and Optimisation
Evaluating our AML systems against internal and external benchmarks
Developing decisioning layers to find optimal trade-offs between precision and recall
Providing data-driven insights on potential outcomes under various scenarios
Operational Process Development
Collaborating with operational teams to refine processes, ensuring effective feedback integration into our automation systems
Designing and managing projects that utilise excess operational capacity, such as manual data labelling for model improvement
Creating systems which provide in-depth insight to investigators on red flags and typologies present on profiles/transactions
Deployment and Implementation
Packaging algorithms into deployable libraries/objects and transitioning them from staging to production environments
Implementing and maintaining scheduled processes for data gathering and model retraining using automated pipelines
Maintaining production-grade Python services

Wise::744000152773029.title: Senior Product Engineer - Partner Experience
Wise::744000152773029.text:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
Wise Platform helps banks, software companies, and large enterprises use Wise's infrastructure to offer their customers cross-border payment products through our API. We're a cross-functional team across sales, implementation, product, engineering, compliance, and analytics, based in New York, London, and Singapore.
We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Partner Experience team in London.
The Partner Experience team builds and runs the systems that let enterprise partners go live faster and manage their day-to-day operations in one place.
We own the Partner Portal (used by many big banks to manage transfers, report fraud, handle compliance requests, and manage their teams) and the backend services behind partner onboarding, permissions, and communication. Most of what we build is new. There's no existing playbook for enterprise partner tooling at this scale, so you'll be designing systems from scratch more often than maintaining existing ones.
How we work:
We're a small team that ships frequently and iterates on real partner feedback. Engineers own features from technical discovery and design through to production support. We work closely with our PM and designer to understand partner needs, and with adjacent teams (API Experience, Account Discovery, KYC, FinCrime) to pull their capabilities into the portal.
We investigate before we build. That means managing ambiguity, understanding the existing systems, APIs and dependencies before writing code. We keep process light: quick standups, focused 1:1s, and quarterly planning.
What will you be working on?:
Backend microservices for partner-facing features: fraud reporting, case management, RFI handling, audit logging, and transaction visibility.
The permissions and role-based access control system that governs what partners can do in the portal.
SSO (SAML 2.0) integration for enterprise partners, including solving identity mapping between partner systems and Wise.
The communication layer services between Wise and partners, extending them to handle new case types and workflows.
API design for partner-facing endpoints. We care about consistency, documentation, and making them usable without hand-holding.
Work with FinCrime, Compliance, and KYC teams to bring sanctions RFI workflows and fraud reporting into the portal.
Technical discovery: mapping existing systems, evaluating dependencies, producing design documents that become the team's source of truth.
Production support and debugging when live partner issues come up.
What do you need:
Experience designing, building, and deploying backend microservices in Java and Spring Boot.
Familiarity with domain-driven design, event-driven architecture, and microservices patterns. You think in terms of domain boundaries, aggregates, and service responsibilities.
Experience designing and maintaining RESTful APIs commercially. Comfort with OpenAPI/Swagger, OAuth2, and versioning strategies.
Ability to design and maintain relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL), including query performance, indexing, and data modelling.
You enjoy mapping complex technical landscapes: understanding existing systems, dependencies, and constraints before proposing solutions. You write clear documentation of what you find.
You deliver reliably and manage your own work without needing constant check-ins
You work well with adjacent teams, unblock yourself when dependencies come up, and build relationships that go beyond PR reviews.
You understand what large enterprise customers need from software: reliability, auditability, compliance, and security as design constraints, not bolt-ons.
Nice to have:
Experience building enterprise portals, partner platforms, or B2B SaaS products.
Understanding of payments systems and the complexities of cross-border money movement.
Experience with identity and access management (SAML, SSO, SPIFFE, OAuth2).
Familiarity with Kafka or other event streaming platforms.
Experience in a platform team serving multiple internal or external consumers.
Ability to explain technical decisions to non-technical people (product managers, partners, compliance teams).
Interest in international finance, foreign exchange, or payments infrastructure.
